jobs.title: Service Representative - Power
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Service Representative - Power**

As a Service Representative, you will be one of Schneider Electric's technical experts at customer sites. You will help customers maximize the safety, performance, reliability, and lifespan of their electrical installations through commissioning, preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, modernization, and emergency support.

You will work closely with customers, Services teams, and technical experts to resolve issues effectively and help ensure customer operations continue safely and efficiently.

**What will you do?**

* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical equipment and systems.
* Install, test, and commission low- and medium-voltage electrical equipment up to 36 kV, in line with product scope and authorization.
* Troubleshoot electrical equipment, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective actions.
* Conduct technical inspections, testing, adjustments, diagnostics, and functional checks.
* Carry out modernization, retrofit, and upgrade activities for installed electrical equipment.
* Respond to customer breakdowns and urgent technical issues when required.
* Complete safety preparation and risk assessment before starting work at customer sites.
* Execute field activities in accordance with Schneider Electric safety, quality, and environmental requirements and applicable Indonesian regulations.
* Prepare accurate service reports and technical documentation after each intervention.
* Maintain accurate work-order, service-activity, and customer installed-base information.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and next steps clearly to customers.
* Coordinate with Services teams and technical experts when escalation or additional support is required.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Education**
-------------

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline.
* Bachelor's degree (S1) in a relevant engineering discipline is an advantage.

**Experience**
--------------

* Hands-on experience in electrical maintenance, commissioning, troubleshooting, or field service in industrial, commercial, infrastructure, data center, utility, or similar environments.
* Exposure to LV/MV electrical distribution equipment, including switchgear, circuit breakers, protection systems, transformers, or related equipment, is preferred.
* Fresh graduates with strong hands-on technical capability may be considered for an entry-level position, depending on business needs.

**Technical and Professional Skills**
-------------------------------------

* Strong understanding of electrical systems and safe working practices.
* Ability to read electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capability.
* Comfortable using digital tools for field-service documentation and reporting.
* Customer-focused with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Able to work independently at customer sites and collaborate effectively with the wider Services team.
* Organized, disciplined, and able to prioritize multiple service activities.
* Able to remain effective when handling urgent customer or equipment issues.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fluent in spoken and written Bahasa Indonesia.
* Working proficiency in English for technical documentation, manuals, training, and communication with technical experts.
* Willing and able to travel frequently to customer sites across Indonesia.
* Willing to work outside normal business hours, including standby, emergency service, weekends, or public holidays when required.
* Willing to work in industrial and customer-site environments and comply with site-specific HSE requirements.
* A valid Indonesian driving license appropriate to the role's mobility requirements is preferred.
* Relevant electrical or HSE competency certification applicable to the assigned scope is an advantage.

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

*Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*  
  
*Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.*

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Service Representative - Automation**

As a Service Representative - Automation, you will be one of Schneider Electric's technical experts at customer sites. You will deliver field services for industrial automation and control systems, helping customers improve equipment availability, process performance, cybersecurity awareness, and operational reliability through commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle support.

You will work closely with customers, Services teams, and technical experts to resolve issues effectively and help ensure customer operations continue safely and efficiently.

**What will you do?**

* Install, configure, test, and commission industrial automation and control systems at customer sites.
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication networks, variable speed drives, and related control equipment.
* Diagnose hardware, software, communication, and application issues; identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
* Back up, restore, and update system configurations, application programs, firmware, and technical documentation in accordance with approved procedures.
* Conduct functional tests, loop checks, system integration tests, and performance verification.
* Support modernization, migration, retrofit, and upgrade activities for installed automation systems.
* Apply appropriate change-control, access-control, and cybersecurity practices during field interventions.
* Respond to customer breakdowns and urgent technical issues, including escalation to product or application experts when required.
* Complete safety preparation and risk assessment before starting work at customer sites.
* Prepare accurate service reports, configuration records, and customer recommendations after each intervention.
* Maintain accurate work-order, service-activity, and installed-base information.
* Communicate technical findings and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Education**
-------------

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in a relevant engineering discipline, such as Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Refrigeration, or a closely related field appropriate to the specialization.
* Bachelor's degree (S1) in a relevant engineering discipline is an advantage.

**Experience**
--------------

* Hands-on experience in industrial automation, control-system commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, or field service.
* Experience with PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication protocols, variable speed drives, control panels, and instrumentation is preferred.
* Exposure to Schneider Electric platforms such as Modicon, EcoStruxure Control Expert, EcoStruxure Machine Expert, AVEVA System Platform, or similar industrial automation platforms is an advantage.
* Fresh graduates with strong automation fundamentals and practical laboratory or internship experience may be considered for an entry-level position.

**Technical and Professional Skills**
-------------------------------------

* Strong understanding of industrial automation architecture, control logic, and electrical control systems.
* Ability to read control drawings, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, network architecture, and technical documentation.
* Basic programming and diagnostic capability for PLC, HMI, or SCADA systems.
* Understanding of Ethernet-based and serial industrial communication networks.
* Systematic troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capability.
* Comfortable using engineering software and digital field-service tools.
* Customer-focused communication and the ability to work independently at customer sites.
* Organized and able to manage urgent technical issues while following change-control procedures.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fluent in spoken and written Bahasa Indonesia.
* Working proficiency in English for technical documentation, manuals, training, and communication with technical experts.
* Willing and able to travel frequently to customer sites across Indonesia.
* Willing to work outside normal business hours, including standby, emergency service, weekends, or public holidays when required.
* Willing to work in industrial, commercial, data-center, and other customer-site environments and comply with site-specific HSE requirements.
* A valid Indonesian driving license appropriate to the role's mobility requirements is preferred.
* Relevant automation, industrial networking, cybersecurity, electrical, or HSE certification is an advantage.

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

jobs.title: DEVELOPER TEAM LEAD
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Spesifikasi Fisik**
---------------------

Tinggi Min.

170 cm

Berat Min.

50 kg

**Deskripsi Pekerjaan**
-----------------------

* Menyusun roadmap pengembangan Holy POS berdasarkan prioritas bisnis, kebutuhan operasional outlet, masukan user, serta integrasi dengan sistem lain seperti inventory, finance, CRM, membership, dan reporting dashboard perusahaan.
* Mengawasi arsitektur sistem dan struktur kode untuk memastikan standar clean code, keamanan sistem, scalability, serta performa aplikasi tetap terjaga seiring bertambahnya jumlah outlet dan volume transaksi harian.
* Berkoordinasi dengan stakeholder lintas departemen seperti Operations, Finance, IT Infrastructure, Internal Audit, dan Management untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi spesifikasi teknis yang jelas dan dapat dieksekusi oleh tim developer.
* Melakukan code review secara berkala untuk memastikan kualitas pengembangan, mencegah bug kritikal, meisir technical debt, serta memastikan implementasi best practice dalam pengembangan software.
* Mengontrol stabilitas sistem Holy POS termasuk monitoring server, database performance, integrasi API, serta memastikan downtime dapat dikan melalui sistem monitoring dan preventive maintenance yang terstruktur.
* Mengelola proses testing (UAT & QA) sebelum rilis fitur baru, termasuk memastikan seluruh modul seperti transaksi penjualan, split bill, refund, discount, pajak, inventory deduction, dan laporan keuangan berjalan akurat dan sesuai SOP outlet.
* Menangani troubleshooting dan incident management untuk isu kritikal yang berdampak pada operasional outlet, serta memastikan penyelesaian masalah dilakukan secara cepat, terdokumentasi, dan disertai analisis root cause.

**Persyaratan**
---------------

* S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Komputer atau bidang relevan
* Pengalaman minimal 2 - 3 Tahun sebagai Developer Team Lead
* Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Time Management, Team Work, Communication Skill, Time Management
* Technical Competency: Backend Development (Node.js / PHP / Java / .NET), Database Management (MySQL / PostgreSQL), API Development & Integration, System Architecture Design, Code Review & Version Control (Git)

**Ringkasan lowongan**
----------------------

Kategori

FULLTIME

Departemen

HOLYPOS DEPARTMENT

Outlet

SENTRAL JELUPANG 2

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
* Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide.
* Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.
* Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements.

**Where this role sits**
------------------------

You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDE and an FDX,

* **Forward Deployed Executives (FDX)** own the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs.
* **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE)** embed with a client, map the client workflow, identify the business problem underneath it, design and build a working AI solution, present to the client, and transfer the knowledge to the client's team. Owns technical direction of the whole solution.
* **Senior AI Engineer.** When an FDE comes back from the client with the business problem, you will help turn that into an agentic system that runs in production and will be responsible for evaluation, observability, and guardrails. You'll have real ownership of components and of the technical decisions inside them.

### **Requirements:**

**Mindset**

* Proactive and self-directed; you push for clarity rather than waiting for a ticket
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership.
* B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams.

**Technical depth**

* 5+ years in software or ML engineering, with production systems you were accountable for.
* Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes.

* Shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks.
* Agentic orchestration: multi-step workflows, graph-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure
* Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks.

* Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production.
* Strong engineering fundamentals. Full-stack mindset, comfortable across AI, backend development, and cloud infrastructure. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase, you're productive.
* Hands-on AWS in production: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus.
* Cloud-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines.
* You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release.
* Model and agent monitoring, drift detection.
* Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs.
* Hands-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus.
* MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare.
* Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.
* AWS and Claude Code Certifications
* A2A: you can explain agent-to-agent interoperability
* CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
* Practical experience with one or more use cases from the following: NLP, LLMs, and Recommendation engines.
* Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust).
* Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа

### **Responsibilities:**

* Work in a pair with an FDE and an FDX.
* Build and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud-native data, LLM-based, and agentic AI solutions).
* Build and optimize RAG systems for production use cases
* Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature.
* Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer.
* Integrate AI components into backend services and RESTful APIs
* Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD. Implement LLMOps and AgentOps practices: agent tracing, prompt and version management, cost and latency monitoring, regression testing, drift detection
* Start from the blueprint, contribute to enablement and handover: clear documentation, runbooks, and pairing with the client engineers who will inherit the system. Feed reusable components and lessons back into the Provectus Blueprints
* Participate in technical discussions and architectural decisions
* Conduct model evaluation, improve failure modes you find, optimize model performance, efficiency, and reliability
* Mentor junior and mid-level AI engineers, conduct code reviews and share knowledge across the team through documentation, presentations, and workshops.

### **What We Offer:**

* The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment
* A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside FDE and FDX
* A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them
* Remote-friendly culture
* Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance
* Career growth; we actively develop our engineers
* Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions
* Long-term B2B collaboration
* Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs
* Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays
* Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work

### **How we hire:**

* Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions.

* Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant

* HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations

* HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Specialist - Firmware & Vulnerability Management Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. As a **Firmware & Vulnerability Management Engineer** , you will play a critical role in maintaining the stability, security, and interoperability of our AI and high-performance computing infrastructure.

  

You will be responsible for managing firmware and software baselines across server, GPU, network, and platform components while assessing cybersecurity vulnerabilities, planning remediation activities, and ensuring infrastructure changes are introduced safely through rigorous testing and rollback planning. Your work will help protect platform availability while enabling secure and compliant operations at scale.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Manage and maintain approved firmware, driver, BIOS, BMC, NIC, GPU, and network device baselines across infrastructure environments.
* Monitor, assess, and prioritize security vulnerabilities (CVEs) using vendor advisories, threat intelligence, and internal risk management processes.
* Evaluate the operational impact of firmware, driver, and security updates on platform stability, performance, and interoperability.
* Develop and maintain compatibility matrices covering server hardware, operating systems, GPUs, network devices, firmware, and drivers.
* Plan, coordinate, and execute firmware and patch testing activities in controlled environments before production deployment.
* Design and document rollback and recovery procedures to minimize operational risk during upgrades and remediation activities.
* Support change management processes by preparing implementation plans, risk assessments, testing evidence, and deployment documentation.
Collaborate with infrastructure, operations, platform engineering, cybersecurity, and vendor teams to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable platform operations.  

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

  

At Kyndryl, learning is embedded in everything we do. In this role, you'll gain exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure, large-scale enterprise platforms, and modern security practices while working alongside industry-leading engineers and technology partners.

  

You'll have opportunities to deepen your expertise in infrastructure lifecycle management, vulnerability management, platform engineering, cybersecurity, automation, and large-scale data center operations. Whether your career path leads toward platform architecture, cybersecurity leadership, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure management, Kyndryl provides the support and development opportunities to help you grow.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  
  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **5+ years of experience** in infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware management, vulnerability management, platform operations, or related infrastructure engineering functions.
* Experience managing firmware, drivers, BIOS, BMC, NIC, storage, networking, and platform software lifecycles within enterprise or data center environments.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management practices, including CVE assessment, risk prioritization, remediation planning, and compliance reporting.
* Experience reviewing and interpreting vendor advisories, security bulletins, release notes, and interoperability documentation.
* Knowledge of infrastructure compatibility management across server platforms, operating systems, GPUs, networking components, and firmware releases.
* Hands-on experience performing patch validation, firmware testing, change implementation, and production rollout planning.
* Experience designing, documenting, and executing rollback and recovery procedures for infrastructure changes.
* Familiarity with change management, incident management, problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), and operational governance processes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to assess technical risk and operational impact.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in **English** .

  
  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience supporting AI, GPU, HPC, or large-scale data center environments.
* Knowledge of server platforms from NVIDIA, Supermicro, Dell Technologies, HPE, Lenovo, or similar enterprise infrastructure vendors.
* Experience managing GPU drivers, BMC firmware, BIOS updates, NIC firmware, and network switch firmware.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms, including Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or similar solutions.
* Experience working with enterprise change management frameworks and ITIL practices.
* Knowledge of operating system patching and lifecycle management across Linux and Windows environments.
* Experience developing automation for compliance validation, reporting, firmware inventory, or vulnerability remediation activities.
* Relevant certifications in infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, or vulnerability management disciplines.
Experience supporting regulated, highly available, or mission-critical environments.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

disciplines. jobs.title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**About UltaHost**

UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth.

**Job Overview**

UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled **Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)** to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using **Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript**
* Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services
* Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL,
* MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate
* Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience
* Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Production experience with Node.js and NestJS
* Strong experience with React and Next.js
* Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis
* Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks
* Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar
* Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation
* Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms
* Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms
* Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems
* Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international technology company
* Professional and collaborative engineering environment
* Remote-first work culture
* Career growth and professional development opportunities
* Opportunity to work with modern AI-native development workflows
* Exposure to large-scale cloud infrastructure and global software products
* Dynamic and innovation-driven company culture

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**About the role**

We build software for a regulated, safety-critical industry, where the decisions our users make have to be accurate, traceable, and defensible. Our clients rely on the product in their day-to-day operations, and the work is a mix of improving what exists and building what clients need next.

**What you will do**

* Build and maintain features end to end across a React frontend and a Python backend
* Design REST APIs and data models on PostgreSQL, with permissions, auditability, and data integrity built in
* Work on geospatial and document-generation features
* Keep calculation-heavy logic correct through versioned rules and regression tests
* Diagnose production issues and strengthen automated tests and CI
* Support user testing, go-live, and ongoing client-driven fixes

**What you bring**

* Strong TypeScript/React and Python for production services
* Solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query performance, and row-level security
* REST API design and authorization (JWT, role-based access)
* Hands-on Supabase (Auth, RLS, RPC) and Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, R2, Zero Trust)
* Docker, GitHub Actions, and Linux server operations
* Experience integrating OIDC/SAML single sign-on
* Practical geospatial data handling (PostGIS, GeoJSON, or equivalent)
* A testing habit, strong Git and code-review practice, and comfort shipping to production
* English and Bahasa Indonesia

**Nice to have**

* Mapping or 3D libraries (MapLibre, Leaflet, Three.js)
* DOCX/PDF generation and LibreOffice or Gotenberg
* Domain knowledge in aviation safety, UAS operations, or another regulated compliance domain
* Experience in the Unmanned Systems or Aerospace
* Experience owning features end to end on a small team

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]**

**Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.**

Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda.

Apa yang akan Anda lakukan:

Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka).

Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain.

Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API.

Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue).

Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim.

Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif.

Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan.

Kualifikasi Utama:

Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend.

Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate).

Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**.

Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing.

Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**.

Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern).

Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito).

Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes.

Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code.

Nilai Tambah:

Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library.

Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll).

Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins).

Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting.

Informasi Tambahan:

Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor.

Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja.

Work Location: In person

Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code. Nilai Tambah: Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library. Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins). Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting. Informasi Tambahan: Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor. Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Designation

Software Engineer-2

Job Title

Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]

Job Description

We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption.

  
  

**About E-Money**

As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system).

  
  

**About Flip**

Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app.

  
  

After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.

  
  

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

  
  
  

**What you'll do**

* Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features.
* Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others.
* Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap.
* Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap.
* Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack.
  

  

**What you'll need**

* Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.
* Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable.
* Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus.
* Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus.
* Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.
* Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Designation

Software Engineer-1

Job Title

Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core

Job Description

We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance.

  
  

**About Core Payment Platform**

As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services.

  
  

**About Flip**

Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year.

We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.**

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

  
  

**What you’ll do**

* Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem.
* Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go.
* Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features.
* Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance.
  

  

**What you’ll need**

* Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus).
* Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles.
* Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
* Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team.
* Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning.
  

  

**Why join Flip?**

* Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems.
* Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia.
* Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment.
* Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**About the GEO Team**
----------------------

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will take on a **hybrid role that combines people management with hands-on engineering**. You will be responsible for the growth and effectiveness of the team, and you will also write code, review pull requests, and shape technical designs alongside them. On this team, leads stay close to the work. Hands-on contribution is a core part of the role, not something you step back from as the team grows.

You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **People leadership**

* Lead and develop the GEO backend team. This covers hiring, regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and supporting each engineer’s growth.
* Own delivery with Product. Shape priorities, make sure commitments are realistic, and remove blockers so the team ships steadily.
* Build the engineering culture of the team: shared standards, constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership of quality.

### **Hands-on engineering**

* Contribute regularly to design, code, and reviews as an active member of the team, not only as a reviewer or approver.
* Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms.
* Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results.
* Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers.
* Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation.
* Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake.

**Your Profile**
----------------

### **Must have**

* Proven experience leading an engineering team with genuine people responsibility (hiring, 1:1s, performance, and delivery) while continuing to contribute code and technical design.
* Motivation to stay hands-on as a lead, balancing management responsibilities with regular engineering work.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Groovy; proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus.
* Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems.
* Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services.
* An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing.
* Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure.
* The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
* Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks.

No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

#### **Build the backbone of BYD's supply chain digital ecosystem — architect high-performance backend systems powering operations across Indonesia and beyond.**

#### **Location: Subang, Indonesia**

### **Job Responsibilities**

* Oversee the back-end technical system planning, architecture design and continuous iteration of the supply chain business line, to guarantee the forward-looking design, stability and scalability of the systems.
* Take the lead in major business projects and core system reconstruction, and resolve technical challenges including high concurrency, high availability and data consistency.
* Formulate and drive the implementation of development specifications, quality standards and performance baselines for the team.
* Act as the technical lead, take charge of core talent cultivation and echelon building, and conduct critical technical decision-making and technical reviews.
* Gain an in-depth understanding of business, participate in product and business planning, and translate complex business requirements into efficient and implementable technical solutions.
* Keep track of industry technical trends and formulate the evolution roadmap of the team's technology stack.

* Bachelor's degree or above; majors related to Computer Science such as Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media Technology and Electronic Information are preferred.
* Solid English skills in reading, writing and communication; proficiency in an additional foreign language is a plus.

* Solid foundational knowledge of Java, proficient in IO, multithreading, collections and mainstream basic frameworks, in-depth research on underlying principles, and familiar with the internal operating mechanism of JVM.
* Skilled in mainstream development frameworks including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
* Experienced with message queues (Kafka), distributed cache, ElasticSearch and other middleware technologies.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact.

Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here.

You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build.

### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**

* Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack.
* Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale.
* Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast.
* Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture.
* Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on.
* Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building.
* Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible.
* Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible.

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field.
* Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems.
* Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early.
* System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments.
* First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job.
* You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking.
* Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles.
* Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed.
* You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today.
* Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly.

### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious.
* Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology.
* Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story.
* Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward.

### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:**

* Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production.
* Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about.
* Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend (multiple seniority level available)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Company Description**

GudangAda is a leading B2B marketplace platform with USD 120+ million raised from Sequoia Capital, Alpha JWC, Asia Partner, and Falcon Edge. We focus on addressing the underserved needs of millions of traditional retailers in Indonesia, a segment that faces challenges including limited product variety, uncompetitive wholesale prices, lack of access to producers’ promotional support, and lack of reliable and cost-effective delivery services.

 **Job Description**

Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka.

Responsibilities:

* You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Frontend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base.
* You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business.
* You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems.
* You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues.
* You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code.
* You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

  
**Qualifications**

We are looking for someone with:

* Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms.
* You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team.
* You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability.
* You are a strong communicator. Explaining complex technical concepts to designers, support, and other engineers is no problem for you.
* You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, programming languages, distributed systems, and information retrieval.
* You have **completed** a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent training, fellowship, or work experience.

  
**Additional Information**

What will you get on working at GudangAda?

* Competitive salary
* Learning experience
* Personal Growth
* Impact at scale
* Mentorship from a world-class team

jobs.title: Sales Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Kami merupakan perusahaan distributor building material terkemuka di wilayah Jabodetabek. Saat ini kami sedang membuka kesempatan untuk mengisi posisi sebagai:

**SALES DATA ANALYST**

**Tugas dan Tanggungjawab:**

* Melakukan analisa dan pengolahan data penjualan masing-masing area, produk maupun sales
* Melakukan penarikan data penjualan dari sistem Accurate
* Melakukan analisa terkait kendala penjualan produk ke customer
* Melakukan koordinasi dengan divisi sales dalam melakukan penyelesaian kendala penjualan
* Melakukan pembuatan purchase order ke para principal.

**Kualifikasi:**

* Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan
* Berpengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Sales Data Analyst di industri building material
* Terbiasa bekerja dengan minim supervisi dan secara mobile
* Memiliki SIM C dan kendaraan sendiri
* Mahir dalam penggunaan software ACCURATE, excel dan word.
* Mahir dalam pengelohan dan penyajian data

Lokasi penempatan: Cilincing - Jakarta Utara

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: IT Quality Assurance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Tipe Pekerjaan : Permanen

Lokasi : Jakarta

Lamar Sebelum: 31 Okt 2026

**Tugas & Tanggung Jawab**
--------------------------

* Meninjau kebutuhan bisnis (*business requirements*) dan proses bisnis secara menyeluruh (*end-to-end*), termasuk mengidentifikasi kesenjangan antara kebutuhan bisnis, solusi yang diimplementasikan, dan cakupan pengujian.
* Menyusun dan melaksanakan *test plan* yang mencakup skenario positif, negatif, pengecualian (*exception*), fungsional, integrasi, *end-to-end*, dan regresi.
* Mendokumentasikan hasil pengujian beserta bukti pendukung secara akurat dan lengkap.
* Mengidentifikasi *defect*, menganalisis dampaknya terhadap proses bisnis, menindaklanjuti penyelesaiannya, serta melakukan validasi atas perbaikan sistem sebelum proses *closure*.
* Berkoordinasi dengan Business Analyst, Developer, Business User, Vendor, dan pihak terkait lainnya selama proses pengujian.
* Menyusun laporan perkembangan pengujian, isu, risiko, dan hambatan (*blocker*), mendukung persiapan *User Acceptance Testing (UAT)*, serta memastikan dokumentasi pengujian terkelola dengan baik.

**Kualifikasi**
---------------

* Minimal lulusan S1 dari berbagai jurusan yang relevan.
* Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang *Software Quality Assurance* (QA), termasuk pengujian fungsional, integrasi, dan regresi.
* Berpengalaman melakukan API Testing menggunakan Postman atau *tools* sejenis, termasuk validasi *request, response,* dan *error handling*.
* Menguasai SQL untuk melakukan validasi transaksi, pengecekan akurasi data, serta investigasi ketidaksesuaian data.
* Mampu menganalisis application log dan menelusuri alur data (*data f...*

Lihat lebih banyak

Anda juga dapat mengirimkan CV terbaru Anda ke **recruitment@perdania.co.id** dengan subject line sesuai dengan posisi yang Anda lamar dan tidak lebih dari 3 MB.

jobs.title: Programmer (PHP, Java Developer)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Job Description:**

* Mengembangkan, menguji, dan memelihara aplikasi menggunakan **PHP** atau **Java** sesuai kebutuhan proyek.
* Merancang dan mengembangkan kode program yang aman, efisien, dan mudah dipelihara.
* Mengintegrasikan aplikasi dengan database serta memastikan performa dan keamanan data tetap optimal.
* Mengembangkan dan mengonsumsi **REST API** untuk kebutuhan integrasi sistem.
* Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, dan perbaikan bug guna memastikan aplikasi berjalan dengan baik.
* Melakukan maintenance dan enhancement terhadap sistem yang sudah berjalan.
* Berkolaborasi dengan System Analyst, QA, dan tim terkait selama proses pengembangan aplikasi.
* Melakukan dokumentasi kode dan pengembangan sistem sesuai standar perusahaan.
* Berpartisipasi dalam code review serta memberikan rekomendasi untuk peningkatan kualitas aplikasi.

**Requirements:**

* Minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang **Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi**, atau jurusan terkait.
* Terbuka untuk **Fresh Graduate** maupun kandidat dengan pengalaman **1–2 tahun** sebagai Programmer atau Software Developer.
* Menguasai salah satu bahasa pemrograman **PHP** atau **Java**.
* Memahami konsep **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)** dan framework yang relevan.
* Untuk Java, memiliki pemahaman mengenai **Core Java**, **Spring Boot**, atau **Hibernate** menjadi nilai tambah.
* Menguasai database relasional seperti **MySQL** atau **PostgreSQL**.
* Memahami dasar **HTML, CSS, JavaScript,** dan **jQuery**.
* Memahami konsep **REST API** dan mampu melakukan integrasi API.
* Terbiasa menggunakan **Git** sebagai version control.
* Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan analytical thinking yang baik.
* Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
* Memiliki kemauan belajar yang tinggi serta mampu beradaptasi dengan teknologi baru.

Application Question(s):

* Notice Periode?
* What is your expectation salary?

Education:

* S1 (Required)

Experience:

* PHP: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (26-07001)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.**
------------------------------------------------------

Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas.

  

### **Detail Pekerjaan**

* Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors.
* Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app.
* Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function.
* Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography.
* Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life.
* Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product.
* Document design standards and best practices.

### **Persyaratan Keahlian**

* Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer.
* Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc.
* Must have experience in mobile and web design.
* Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies.
* Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result.
* Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography.
* Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs.

### **Tingkat Pendidikan**

* Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.
