Jakarta, ID

**Are you ready to unleash your potential?**

  

At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

  

We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices.

  

Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals.

  

We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognised for their contributions.

  

Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now!

  

**Work you'll do**

  

This role is with Deloitte Digital Southeast Asia. Across all clients and sectors, we believe great customer experiences create greater impact. That elevating the human experience creates enduring value, for the organization, for the customer, for society, for all.

  

As part of Customer Strategy & Design (CS&D), you will work with team to help our clients with their Brand Experiences, Products and Services, Innovation Strategies, Digital Venturing and Customer Experiences, bridging Business and Customer strategies by design. We help clients connect People, Product, Purpose and Profit through the use of strategy, design and technology.

  

Key Responsibilities:

  

* Design intuitive, visually engaging, and scalable user interfaces for large-scale digital platforms, including super apps, mobile applications, and complex web ecosystems.
* Translate business requirements, user insights, and UX wireframes into high-quality UI designs, interactive prototypes, and production-ready design specifications.
* Apply design system principles, reusable components, and visual standards to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability across multiple features and digital touchpoints.
* Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to deliver seamless digital experiences aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* Contribute to design reviews, usability testing, and iterative improvements to enhance usability, visual quality, and overall customer experience.
* Support end-to-end design delivery, including developer handover, design QA, and refinement of implemented interfaces to ensure design fidelity.
  

**Your role as a leader:**

  

At Deloitte, we believe in the importance of empowering our people to be leaders at all levels. We connect our purpose and shared values to identify issues as well as to make an impact that matters to our clients, people and the communities. Additionally, Consultants across our Firm are expected to:

  

* Actively seek out developmental opportunities for growth, act as strong brand ambassadors for the firm as well as share their knowledge and experience with others.
* Respect the needs of their colleagues and build up cooperative relationships.
* Understand the goals of our internal and external stakeholder to set personal priorities as well as align their teams’ work to achieve the objectives.
* Constantly challenge themselves, collaborate with others to deliver on tasks and take accountability for the results.
* Build productive relationships and communicate effectively in order to positively influence teams and other stakeholders.
* Offer insights based on a solid understanding of what makes Deloitte successful.
* Project integrity and confidence while motivating others through team collaboration as well as recognising individual strengths, differences, and contributions.
* Understand disruptive trends and promote potential opportunities for improvement.
  

**Requirements:**

* Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in UI design for digital products, preferably within digital consulting, product design, or technology-driven environments.
* Proven experience designing large-scale digital properties, such as super apps, multi-service platforms, digital banking applications, or complex consumer-facing ecosystems.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating visual design excellence, responsive interfaces, interaction design, and the ability to manage complex user journeys and multiple product features.
* Proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems, component libraries, prototyping, and developer handover.
* Good understanding of usability, accessibility, responsive design principles, and platform-specific UI guidelines.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business, design, and technology teams.
  

**Due to volume of applications, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.**

  

**Please note that Deloitte will never reach out to you directly via messaging platforms to offer you employment opportunities or request for money or your personal information. Kindly apply for roles that you are interested in via this official Deloitte website.**

jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Job Overview:**

The Civil Engineer applies their conceptual knowledge of civil and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward civil problems. They will be responsible for analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents.

  

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  
  
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Perform FEED, Studies, and detailed design engineering, analysis, and calculations on more complex and demanding engineering tasks
* Apply knowledge and skills to complete varied assignments
* Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses, including design reports and procedures
* Prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines
* Focus on completing work within budgets
* Communicate and explain information in straightforward engineering activities
* Gain familiarity with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements, including identifying concerns as early as practicable
* Initiate interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs
* Perform computer analyses of foundations and structures designed by others with guidance from Senior/Principal Engineers
* Prepare design calculations as required
* Assist in the preparation of specifications with guidance from colleagues
* Perform engineering check of drafting
* Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline
* Perform design verification through single discipline check and assist with inter-discipline checks (IDC)
* Prepare & review MTOs of foundations and structures under the supervision
* Provide engineering support as required
* Assist in the preparation of subcontract documents
* Review vendor data
Assist in bid evaluations  

Reports to: Project: Lead Engineer
  
Functional: Supervising Department Manager
  
Liaise With: All design/drafting disciplines, all Engineering disciplines, Construction site/Fabrication groups, and Document
  
Control
  
Supervises: Trainee Engineers

  

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering
* 3-8 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant, predominantly performing detail design
* Preferably Registered Engineer in Training (EIT) or member of a professional engineering society as applicable
* Eager to learn
* Working knowledge of English, both oral and written
* HSE, TQM, and cost-conscious
* Show flexibility and ensure proper hand-over with regard to:
  + The reassignment to other departments, construction sites, and fabrication yards
  + The replacement of colleagues during illness and holidays.
  + The provision of assistance to other colleagues with heavy workloads (also other projects) when possible/desirable
  + The managing/learning of future current working methods and software applications
* Accredited engineering degree as may be required by specific regions
* Familiar with the use of codes and standards
* Familiar with the content and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable. Knowledge of many basic design techniques and analysis methods
* Minimum 5-10 years working experience in the heavy construction industry.
* Able to use MS office, 2D AutoCAD, able do to Civil/Mechanical/Electrical analysis would be an advantage.
Fluent in English both oral and written.  

#LI-LD1

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Critical Environment Electrical Engineer.**

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Electrical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**:

***Design***

* Develop basic knowledge of industry trends, competitors' products, customer experience, and advances in various engineering fields. Consult with other engineers to help understand and apply advanced concepts.
* Assist in the creation and execution of robust, scalable, secure, and extensible designs and/or verification plans for the electrical engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product extension (e.g., a product refresh, or line extension).
* Participate in creating intellectual property. May file patents within personal area of scope and complete necessary patent documentation.
* Implement known solutions to common technical and/or design challenges, with some guidance from other engineers.
* Read device specification sheets and interpret common details required to design and test various hardware features.
* Develop design documentation which could include drawings, specifications, schematics, or diagrams for features of well-defined products with guidance and direction from a manager or other engineers.
* Review supplier or partner technical sheets for available parts and choose appropriate parts needed to support product development.

***Testing and Verification***

* Ensure that test requirements are included in documentation and specifications for a feature or product.
* Determine the appropriate test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for measuring a feature of a product according to existing verification plans, with minimal supervision from other engineers.
* Write design verification test cases using standard templates and test methodologies.
* Develop, review, and execute test plans and/or infrastructure for standard features or products.
* Assist in developing automated testing solutions and independently conduct automated testing on standard feature areas or products.
* Gather data for external testing supplier or partner selection options.
* Assist in setting up and breaking down testing environments with guidance and supervision from other engineers. Follow safety guidelines.
* Participate in the development of dashboards or reports for testing and quality metrics that can be utilized to characterize hardware and hardware performance.
* Analyze and interpret results of data and statistical analyses to identify common problems or flaws that may affect a feature or product design change and bring them to the attention of other engineers or team leads.
* Assist in the development of basic test fixtures for use in testing or validation of new product features under guidance from other engineers.

***Technical Project Implementation***

* Follow project implementation schedules to deliver the hardware engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product. Escalate issues to management as necessary.
* Implement and track product plans, under guidance from other engineers.
* Highlight potential issues that may affect downstream execution of projects (e.g., performance vs. reliability and manufacturing concerns).
* Research new tools, technologies, or processes for project implementation and provide reports to project team members.
* Assist in implementing risk assessments (e.g., supplier or partner delays, incomplete specs, or tool issues) into project plans.
* Communicate project progress/status within the project team and escalate issues as necessary.

***Reporting and Documentation***

* Follow established procedures to participate in creating detailed reports and functional specifications for a well-defined product feature or extension, based on audits and information from product development and verification processes.
* Document essential details about materials, components, and/or assemblies for a device via accepted release processes. Accurately record and track changes to designs following established processes with some guidance from other engineers.

***Other***

* Embody the Microsoft One culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of technical engineering experience
  + OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of technical engineering experience
  + OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**About WegoPro**
-----------------

WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance.
* Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail.
* Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team.
* Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work.
* Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications.
* Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model.
* Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals.
* Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces.
* Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't.
* Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features.
* Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging.
* Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS.
* Experience with micro-frontend architectures.
* Experience building or maintaining design systems.
* Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem.

**Why Join WegoPro?**
---------------------

At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day.

If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

=============================================================

Kami mencari talenta terbaik untuk tumbuh dalam ekosistem kerja yang positif dan suportif. Berbekal belasan tahun pengalaman dan penghargaan, mari wujudkan ide-idemu dan bangun masa depan dunia IT Indonesia bersama Hypernet Technologies.

**Lingkungan Kerja Positif untuk** **Kesuksesan Bersama**
=========================================================

Untuk mewujudkan pengalaman kerja terbaik, ekosistem kolaboratif kami berakar kuat pada lima nilai inti budaya perusahaan, yaitu **S.O.L.I.D.**

### **S****implicity**

Mengutamakan cara kerja yang efisien, praktis, dan efektif tanpa birokrasi rumit guna mencapai hasil kerja yang maksimal.

### **O****pen-Mindedness**

Selalu terbuka terhadap ide-ide baru, adaptif terhadap inovasi, dan menghargai setiap perbedaan demi kemajuan bersama.

### **L****earning Spirit**

Mengutamakan cara kerja yang efisien, praktis, dan efektif tanpa birokrasi rumit guna mencapai hasil kerja yang maksimal.

### **I****ntegrity**

Menjunjung tinggi nilai kejujuran, transparansi, dan etika profesional dalam setiap tindakan maupun pengambilan keputusan.

### **D****ependable**

Menjadi talenta yang selalu dapat diandalkan, tangguh, dan konsisten dalam memberikan dampak positif bagi seluruh klien.

  

### **Lead UI/UX Designer (Bandung)**

**Qualifications:**

1. Four years of experience in UI/UX Leader
  
2. Have education in Design/DKV / Human Computer Interaction or related fields
  
3. Accustomed to planning and executing UI / UX design projects, from start to finish
  
4. An expert Figma and Sketch user with fluency in prototyping software
  
5. An expert Adobe Ilustrator and Adobe Photoshop
  
6. Have the ability to see and communicate your ideas
  
7. Your design is well thought out, purposeful and has intent 8. You love to solve problems creatively and effectively

**Responsibilities:**

1. Defining user goals, models, taxonomy and user interfaces and translating them into wireframes and interactive prototypes java
  
2. Creating, presenting and delivering user flows, wireframes, prototypes, mockups, process maps and feature lists to effectively communicate design ideas
  
3. Crafting comprehensive UI/UX documentation and design artifacts including screen flows and detailed design specifications
  
4. Providing suggestions and recommendations to improve product user experience
  
5. Conceptualizing complicated design ideas and high-level requirements into interactive, intuitive and functional user interfaces
  
6. Managing UI/UX team and responsible for UI/UX Performance
  
7. Assist in planning and conducting usability testing and evaluate user feedback”

  

**Keuntungan & Benefit Bergabung Bersama** **Hypernet Technologies**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Jenis:** Full Time

**Lokasi:** On-Site (Semarang)

Kami sedang mencari UI/UX Designer yang kreatif dan berbakat untuk bergabung dengan Techarea. Sebagai UI/UX Designer, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengubah ide-ide dan konsep menjadi antarmuka pengguna yang menarik dan fungsional.

**Tugas dan Kewajiban:**
------------------------

* Menyiapkan *storyboards*, alur proses, atau *sitemap* untuk memberikan pandangan holistik tentang desain.
* Merancang *wireframe* yang akan menjadi dasar untuk pengembangan antarmuka pengguna.
* Merancang antarmuka pengguna yang konsisten, fungsional, mudah dikembangkan, dan memikat secara visual.
* Membuat *mockup* dan prototipe yang mencerminkan fungsionalitas desain.
* Melakukan iterasi desain hingga mencapai desain yang optimal.
* Bekerja sama secara erat dengan tim developer untuk mengoordinasikan proses *handoff* desain.

**Kualifikasi:**
----------------

* Memahami prinsip-prinsip desain dan praktik terbaik desain UI.
* Memahami prinsip-prinsip UX dan dapat membuat desain UI untuk berbagai perangkat.
* Memahami istilah-istilah dalam bahasa Inggris terkait desain UI/UX.
* Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam dan kemampuan menggunakan aplikasi desain UI/UX.
* Kemampuan bekerja secara mandiri dan berkolaborasi dalam tim.
* Proaktif dan responsif dalam berkomunikasi dengan tim, serta mampu memberikan dan menerima umpan balik dengan konstruktif.
* Pendidikan minimal SMK bidang Teknologi dan Rekayasa, Teknologi Informasi, atau bidang terkait, dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai UI/UX Designer.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer - Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Department Product Management

LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor)

LocationJakarta

The Product Management team at Shopee is the key focal point between the business, engineering and design teams. The team is responsible for implementing strategy, road maps and features, while adhering to business goals. It covers all functions including but not limited to Financial Services, Supply Chain, Search, Recommendation, Advertising, Order, Promotion, User, Anti-Fraud, Seller Service. Join us to own a product that is impacting millions of lives in Southeast Asia and Taiwan.

About the Team:

Shopee is the leading e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. We provide easy, secure, and fast online shopping experiences to our buyers and sellers every day.

We’re looking for a mid-senior UI/UX designer to join us in enhancing our core e-commerce platforms.

  

You will help improve the sellers’ experience in listing products, managing inventory, monitoring shop performance and marketing initiatives, and engaging with buyers through social and engagement features. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams of designers, writers, product managers, operations, and business analysts.

Job Description:

* Shape and design core e-commerce platforms across mobile and web dashboard interfaces within the project scope.
* Develop high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes to effectively present product concepts to key stakeholders and leadership.
* Collaborate closely with product and business counterparts to evaluate project requirements and translate them into intuitive user interfaces.
* Drive user-centric solutions by advocating for user needs during team discussions and brainstorming sessions throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements:

* Hold a minimum Bachelor's degree in Visual Communication Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Possess 1 to 4 years of hands-on experience in UI/UX design or product design for mobile and web dashboard interfaces.
* Demonstrated portfolio showcasing end-to-end design thought processes, with experience in B2B user interfaces.
* Proficient in written and spoken English to facilitate cross-border collaboration, with proficiency in Chinese as an added advantage.
* High degree of ownership and agility to drive deliverables forward within dynamic project timelines.
* Confident and assertive in design decision-making while remaining receptive to constructive feedback.

**Location** Jakarta, Jakarta Special Capital Region, Indonesia **Job ID** R-262814 **Date posted** 31/10/2026

  

**The Asia AZpire Graduate Program** is a **three-year accelerated development journey** designed for ambitious MBA graduates ready to turn their potential into impact.

Through high-impact assignments and cross-functional rotations, you will gain meaningful real-world experience while building commercial and leadership capabilities and a broader enterprise perspective.

Broaden your horizons, grow across functions, and unlock your potential.

**Your journey to becoming a future healthcare leader starts with AZpire.**

**Your AZpire journey**

Over three years, you will gain hands-on experience through cross-functional rotations and meaningful business assignments.

Your journey may include experience across:

* AI & Digital Excellence
* Business Intelligence
* Sales and customer-facing experience
* Marketing
* Medical
* Market Access

***\*\*\*\*Rotation sequence and assignments may vary by market, business needs and individual development goals.***

**What you will experience**

**3 Years: Accelerated Development Journey**

Build your experience progressively through a structured three-year program designed to broaden your capabilities and prepare you for future opportunities.

**Rotations: Real-World Business Experience**

Take on meaningful assignments across different functions and business environments, developing a broader understanding of our customers, patients and healthcare ecosystem.

**Asia Network: Leadership Exposure and Regional Connections**

Grow through mentoring, leadership exposure and connections with colleagues and fellow AZpire Associates across Asia.

**What you will develop**

* Commercial and strategic thinking
* Customer and market understanding
* Data-driven decision-making
* Leadership and influence
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Learning agility and adaptability

**Make an impact from the start**

Depending on your rotation and assignment, you may have the opportunity to:

* Turn customer, patient and market insights into business recommendations
* Support brand, portfolio, launch or go-to-market priorities
* Contribute to patient access and patient pathway initiatives
* Use data and insights to support decision-making
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for ambitious early-career talents who are ready to learn, grow and take on new challenges. You may be a strong fit if you:

* Are a recent MBA graduate
* Have a science-based educational background
* Ideally have 1-5 years of professional experience
* Demonstrate leadership potential and learning agility
* Are open to functional and field rotations
* Are curious, adaptable and willing to take on new challenges
* Have a passion for innovation and improving outcomes for patients
* Meet the local employment and work-authorization requirements for Indonesia.

**Recruitment journey**

Our recruitment process will include the following stages:

**1. Application Launch**

**Timeline: 1 November 2026 - 20 November 2026**

**2. Online Screening**

**Timeline: 23 November 2026 - 30 November 2026**

**3. Final Assessment**

**Timeline: 30 Nov 2026 - 4 Dec 2026**

**4**. **Onboarding**

**Timeline: January untill March 2027**

**\*\*\*\******The start date will depend on the candidate’s availability and notice period.***

**Ready to start your AZpire journey?**

If you are ready to broaden your horizons, grow across functions and turn your potential into impact, your next opportunity could start here.

**Join the Asia AZpire Graduate Program and help shape the future of healthcare.**

**Click here for more information ASIA AZPIRE**

19-Nov-2026

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. jobs.title: Digital Content Creator Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you a passionate storyteller ready to bring Indonesia’s vibrant landscapes and travel experiences to life? We are looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking Digital Content Creator to join our Marketing team. In this role, you will help shape our visual identity, craft compelling digital narratives, and manage our social media platforms with fresh creative energy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Content Creation & Campaigns:**

* Proactively participate in creative brainstorming sessions to develop impactful brand marketing campaigns.
* Produce and edit high-quality visual content (photos and videos), including drone footage, for use across digital channels.
* Be confident and effective behind and in front of the camera when creating content.
* Develop and manage innovative content to expand our brand’s reach.

**Social Media Management:**

* Create engaging content for all social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Twitter, YouTube).
* Actively participate in the development and execution of social media content strategies that align with brand goals.
* Collaborate with the Social & Community Manager to create, schedule, and optimize social media content.
* Drive social media marketing objectives by optimizing strategies to increase engagement, followers, and brand visibility.

**Qualifications:**

* An Indonesian citizen with at least 2 years of proven experience in content creation and social media management, ideally within the travel industry or a related sector.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or any related field.
* Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong creative skills in media content creation and editing, including photography, videography, and drone footage.
* Comfortable with public speaking and appearing on camera for content creation.
* Highly creative, proactive, and independent with a growth-oriented mindset.
* Adaptive, agile, and quick to learn new technologies and trends.
* Passionate about travel and well-versed in Indonesian travel destinations.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Performance Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**The Role**  
We are looking for a Performance Analyst who can independently drive analytics and performance insights for our clients.

This role goes beyond execution, you will be expected to structure problems, propose data-driven solutions, and translate insights into business impact with minimal supervision.

You will work closely with clients, support junior team members, and contribute to growing client accounts by identifying new opportunities and measurement improvements. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical skills, performance marketing knowledge, and business acumen.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze and monitor client performance data, including advanced analyses (funnel drop-off, cohort analysis, audience segmentation).
* Independently generate insights and propose actionable recommendations to improve ROI and business outcomes.
* Translate client business needs into analytical solutions and identify opportunities for further analysis or optimization.
* Forecast and estimate potential business impact of initiatives and performance changes.
* Ideate and plan data-driven solutions leveraging analytics and digital marketing capabilities.
* Present insights and recommendations to clients while managing communication and relationships.
* Assist analytics manager on project deliverables and timelines, reporting bottlenecks, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Support senior stakeholders in business development initiatives, including identifying upsell opportunities.

**Experience & Skills:**

* Minimum 2-4 years in marketing analytics, product analytics, or performance analytics. Exposure to project coordination or project management is preferred.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, especially Google Analytics (GA4) and AppsFlyer, including the ability to explain their core features and use cases.
* Understanding of performance marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Programmatic), including audience targeting, budgeting, and bidding strategies.
* Strong ability to translate analysis into clear insights and well-structured, client-ready presentations.
* Understanding of performance marketing platforms and key metrics (CAC, LTV, ROI, conversion rates).
* Familiarity with attribution and marketing effectiveness measurement, including understanding of the marketing technology such as conversion tracking, attribution setup, CRM, etc.
* Comfortable with external and client facing responsibilities.
* Professional working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and spoken).
* Experience in consulting, tech, or e-commerce is a plus.
* Experience in owned channel (SEO, push notifications), A/B testing, and/or AI/ML is a plus.
* Has an agile mindset, curiosity, and eagerness to learn and adapt with new technologies, trends, and client landscapes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front-End)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **What you will be doing:** * **Ship End-to-End:** Own features from design to release—spot UX gaps early, ship core value first, log tech debt deliberately, and clean it up later. * **Partner with Product:** Analyze technical feasibility, document requirements, estimate timelines, and build work plans alongside product managers. * **Empower the Team:** Unblock peers through prompt PR reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching. * **Work Smarter with AI:** Leverage AI tools for routine tasks (unit tests, docs, clarifications) to maximize time spent on core logic. * **Lead & Architect:** Formulate web frontend architecture, drive tech stack decisions, and uphold engineering best practices. ### **What we need from you:** * **Experience:** **Minimum 3 years** of software engineering experience building Web Frontend applications (**ReactJS**). * **Technical Core:** Strong grasp of web frontend architecture, OOP, and software design patterns. * **Product Mindset:** A strong sense of ownership—treating what you ship as your own codebase is a must. * **Pragmatic Learner:** Drive to learn new technologies and apply them practically to solve business problems. * **Collaborative Spirit:** Outstanding problem-solving skills, open-mindedness to learn from peers, and a desire to elevate your team. **Nice-to-Haves:** * Full-stack versatility and readiness to tackle new frameworks across the stack. * Experience deploying software on scalable cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission. You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. **Our stack:** Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end · Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end · MongoDB + Redis · Git + CI/CD · GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full-Stack Development** * Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI. * Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing. * Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state. **AI-Assisted Development & Oversight** * Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts. * Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI. * Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship. **Collaboration & Delivery** * Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions. * Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production. * **Front end:** proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar). * **Back end:** strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.) * Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design. * Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD. * Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially **Claude Code**) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong. * Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized deployments (Docker or similar). * Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics. * A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools. * Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** Job Description Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka. Responsibilities: * You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base. * You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business. * You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems. * You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues. * You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code. * You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes Tech stack that we use: * Reactjs * NextJS * Typescript * Redux: Library * TailwindCSS * Material UI: Design System **Qualifications** We are looking for someone with: * Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms. * You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team. * You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability. * You are a strong communicator. jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (Full-Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description * Mengembangkan, membangun, dan memelihara aplikasi web dari sisi frontend dan backend sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis perusahaan. * Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan antarmuka pengguna (UI) yang responsif, interaktif, dan mudah digunakan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara server-side logic, API, serta integrasi dengan database dan layanan pihak ketiga. * Merancang, mengelola, dan mengoptimalkan database untuk memastikan keamanan, konsistensi, dan efisiensi pengolahan data. * Mengintegrasikan frontend dengan backend untuk memastikan seluruh fitur aplikasi berjalan dengan baik. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara RESTful API atau layanan API lainnya sesuai kebutuhan sistem. * Melakukan pengujian, debugging, dan troubleshooting untuk mengidentifikasi serta memperbaiki bug atau permasalahan teknis. * Mengoptimalkan performa, skalabilitas, keamanan, dan stabilitas aplikasi. * Melakukan deployment, pemeliharaan, serta pemantauan aplikasi pada lingkungan development, staging, dan production. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara integrasi dengan sistem eksternal, termasuk payment gateway, layanan cloud, dan aplikasi pihak ketiga jika diperlukan. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim UI/UX Designer, Product Manager, QA, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan pengembangan produk sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan spesifikasi. * Melakukan code review, menulis kode yang terstruktur, serta menerapkan standar dan best practices dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak. * Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis, termasuk dokumentasi API, arsitektur sistem, dan alur pengembangan aplikasi. * Mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan dan memberikan rekomendasi teknis untuk meningkatkan kualitas serta efisiensi sistem. * Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan menerapkan solusi yang relevan untuk mendukung pengembangan produk perusahaan. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai Full Stack Developer atau posisi serupa. * Menguasai HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript atau TypeScript untuk pengembangan frontend. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework frontend seperti React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, atau framework sejenis. * Menguasai bahasa pemrograman backend seperti JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, atau bahasa lain yang relevan. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework backend seperti Node.js/Express.js, NestJS, Laravel, Django, atau framework sejenis. * Memahami konsep RESTful API, autentikasi, otorisasi, dan integrasi sistem. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan database relasional maupun nonrelasional, seperti MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau MongoDB. * Memahami Git dan version control untuk pengelolaan kode serta kolaborasi tim. * Memiliki pemahaman mengenai deployment aplikasi, CI/CD, serta layanan cloud menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami prinsip keamanan aplikasi, optimasi performa, dan pengembangan sistem yang skalabel. * Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. * Teliti, proaktif, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu beradaptasi dengan kebutuhan proyek. Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Full-Stack SMPP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Full-Stack SMPP Developer** We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Stack SMPP Developer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing robust SMS gateway solutions and full-stack web applications. You will bridge the gap between complex telecom protocols and modern web interfaces, ensuring seamless, high-volume, and reliable message routing. **Key Responsibilities** * SMPP Integration & Management: Implement, configure, and maintain SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) client/server connections (v3.4/v5.0) with various SMS Centers (SMSC) and telecom aggregators. * Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and deploy scalable front-end and back-end applications that interface with our SMS gateway and core business systems. * System Optimization: Monitor and optimize database queries, API performance, and message queuing systems to handle high-throughput SMS traffic. * Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to SMPP session drops, message delivery failures, and application bugs. * Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, QA engineers, and external telecom partners to deliver reliable communication solutions. * Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices in software development and version control (Git). **Mandatory Qualifications** * Education: Must be a College Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * SMPP Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically working with the SMPP Protocol (e.g., handling SMSC connections, parsing PDUs, managing SMPP sessions, and troubleshooting delivery receipts). * Full-Stack Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of professional experience in Full-Stack Development, demonstrating proficiency in both front-end and back-end technologies. **Technical Skills & Competencies** * Backend Technologies: Proficiency in languages commonly used for SMPP and backend services (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or PHP). * Frontend Technologies: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) and standard HTML/CSS. * SMPP Libraries: Familiarity with SMPP libraries such as Cloudhopper (Java), jSMPP, node-smpp, or Python's smpplib is highly advantageous. * Databases: Solid understanding of relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases. * APIs & Messaging: Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message brokers/queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). * Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills. **Work Setup & Location Details** Hybrid Work Model (A mix of on-site and remote work, specific schedule to be discussed during the interview). On-Site Office: Ruko Citra 7, Jl. Peta Barat No.16 Blok A03, Desa/Kelurahan Kalideres, Kec. Kalideres, Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, Provinsi DKI Jakarta 11840 **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (HMO). * Government-mandated benefits * A collaborative and innovative work environment. * Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth in the telecom-tech space. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * SMPP Protocol: 1 year (Required) * Full-Stack Development: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Overview** Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team. **Role Description** As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation - designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals. Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change. **Key Responsibilities** * **Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation:** Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels. * **AI-Driven Content Orchestration:** Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale. * **Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure:** Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines. * **Performance Marketing Collaboration:** Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels. * **Agentic Workflow Development:** Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows. **Qualifications** **Experience & Domain Expertise** * 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering. * Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust). * Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs. **Technical Skills** * Advanced SQL and Python. * Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows. * Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs. **Soft Skills & Mindset** * Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements. * Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely. * Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.

jobs.title: FDE AI/ Solutions Architect (AI, Python/Data)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDX; our delivery arc is Sprint Enable Realize: * Forward Deployed Executive (FDX) owns the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs — revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction. * Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds with a client to change how that client operates. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. You map the client workflow as it actually happens, identify the business problem underneath it, build a working AI solution, present to the client in the language of outcomes, and transfer it. Provectus maintains industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a client in the same industry — so you begin from running code and tuning it to this client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. You will be measured on whether the Business Unit's number moved, not on hours or scope delivered. ### **What You’ll Do:** **Take the seat** * Sit with the client and the Forward Deployed Executive at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc, and redesign the function from first principles. * Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow. **Build** * Design and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud-native data, LLM-based, and agentic AI solutions). Implement and optimize RAG systems for production use cases * Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design. * Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer. * Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and maintainable after we leave. Hand the system over to the client. * Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from. * Lead architecture reviews, produce technical design documents, and contribute to standards. Mentor engineers and share knowledge across the team. **Own the outcome.** * Work in a pair with a FDX who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number. * Own the technical direction of technical proposals and scoping. Drive adoption. Change management is part of the engineering job here. * Be credible with the customer’s engineers and their executives. * Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. ### **What You’ll Bring:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self-directed; identify problems before they're handed to you * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams **Client Engagement** * You are willing to spend time understanding and doing someone else’s job on the client's side before you write a line of code * Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO, presenting outcomes to them * You can produce a scoped, phased delivery plan with clear deliverables, dependencies, and risks — and estimate what it will cost to build and to run **Technical depth** * 7+ years building and running production systems. * Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes * Designed and shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks * Agentic orchestration: multi-step workflows, graph-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure * Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks. * Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Experience in making and defending architectural trade-off decisions * Hands-on AWS production depth: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus * Cloud-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release * Model and agent monitoring, drift detection * Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs * Hands-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus ### **Nice to have:** * Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery * A2A: you can explain agent-to-agent interoperability * AWS and Claude Code Certifications * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust) * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Having authored a server is a plus ### **Nice to have:** * Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery * A2A: you can explain agent-to-agent interoperability * AWS and Claude Code Certifications * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust) * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Customer Care)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.29 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000424* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Customer Care Engineering builds the systems that decide whether a traveler's worst day ends in frustration or relief. When a flight is cancelled at midnight in Jakarta or a hotel falls through in Bangkok, the tools you ship — agent consoles, automated resolution flows, and the AI that triages millions of interactions across eleven markets — are what turn a problem into a fast, effortless fix. You will work close to the operation, not abstracted away from it, building backend services and customer-facing frontends where every latency improvement and smarter workflow is measured in real people helped. We are not bolting support onto a product; we are engineering care as a first-class part of the journey. If you want your code to visibly change how Southeast Asia travels, you will feel at home here. **About the Job** As a Lead Backend Engineer on Traveloka's Customer Care team, you are a technical expert who designs the systems your area is built on and sets the technical direction others build against, with direct impact on the domain's results. * Design and ship multi-service systems for Customer Care, owning the system-level consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs, and lead deep architecture work that spans services and teams, untangling complex trade-offs across performance, cost, and correctness * Decompose an ambiguous product problem into a service architecture, API contracts, and a plan others can execute * Set the technical bar through rigorous, constructive review, and shape the APIs other teams build against cleanly * Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through review and pairing, growing their judgment without managing them * Act as senior on-call authority on your systems, killing whole classes of incidents through durable design, not patching * Influence the engineering roadmap with technical proposals that shape what the wider team builds next * Direct how the team uses AI tools in its workflow, judging where they speed delivery and where they introduce risk **Job Requirements** * You have at least 3 years of backend engineering — and your judgment on system design now comes from having built and operated systems, however you got there. * You have designed a system that spans multiple services from scratch, and it has held up in production. * You own the consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs at the system level, not just within one service. * You can take an ambiguous product problem and decompose it into a clean service architecture. * You produce clear API contracts and a delivery plan others can execute. * You have owned a system through real scale growth or a reliability turnaround. * You can point to the architectural decisions that made it hold. * You set the technical bar for an area through rigorous, constructive review, and engineers around you get better because of how you review and design. * You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent depth from real-world engineering. * You mentor junior to middle-level engineers deliberately — you grow their judgment, not just unblock their tickets. * You partner with Product to map technical dependencies and shape APIs and integrations that other teams build against cleanly. * You set how your team uses AI tools in its workflow. * You can judge where they accelerate delivery and where they introduce risk worth guarding against. **Join Us** If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you. We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days. We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.
