jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Senior AI Engineer - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. **SCeNe Coalition** The SCeNe Coalition is aimed to develop Triple Benefit Tools and Website for Southeast Asia Climate and Nature-based Solution (SCeNe) Coalition. Triple Benefit Tool will help to identify high impact future NbS opportunities, ensuring a targeted pipeline of NbS supply that focus on geographies with the highest conservation, social development and carbon potential. This tool will also help to validate triple benefit quality, giving the projects additional scientific credibility; to ensure finance is flowing transparently; and to increase ecosystem participation. **Data Lab Indonesia** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The Senior AI Engineer will lead the technical development and evaluation of AI capabilities for the Dynamic Multilingual Translation and Document Generation initiative within the Nature-based Solutions (NbS) Tool. The role focuses on building reliable, source-grounded multilingual translation and AI-assisted document generation capabilities using existing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches. Working under the direct supervision of the Product and Engineering Manager, the Senior AI Engineer will working closely with the Product Manager and Backend Engineers, the consultant will evaluate suitable AI models, design and optimise AI pipelines, establish measurable quality standards, and provide technical guidance for integration into the NbS Tool. The consultant will play a key role in assessing technical feasibility, supporting the project's go/no-go decision, and preparing validated AI components for production deployment, subject to project approval. In support of WRI's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, the post holder will actively contribute to collaborative and inclusive ways of working across the project and organization. **What You Will Do** **AI Engineering, Innovation and System Integration (80%)** * Lead the technical design and development of AI solutions for multilingual translation, RAG, and source-grounded content generation within the NbS Tool. * Evaluate and compare existing AI models, including SeaLLM, SEA-LION, and other suitable alternatives, and recommend approaches based on quality, performance, operational cost, and technical feasibility. * Develop and optimise multilingual translation capabilities, prioritising the existing Indonesian translation solution and a RAG-based approach for one additional Southeast Asian language. * Improve RAG retrieval quality, source grounding, citation traceability, and robustness to ensure AI-generated content is reliable and supported by relevant source materials. * Design and implement repeatable evaluation processes using appropriate automated metrics and human assessment to measure translation and content-generation quality against agreed success criteria. * Develop and provide AI components and technical guidance to support integration with the NbS Tool's feasibility-report generation workflow, in collaboration with Backend Engineers. * Support testing, technical optimisation, and production readiness of AI components, including performance, reliability, integration, and operational cost considerations, subject to the project's go/no-go decision. * Prepare technical documentation covering AI architecture, model configurations, evaluation results, integration requirements, known limitations, and maintenance recommendations. **Program Management (20%)** * Translate project requirements into feasible AI technical approaches, development priorities, and measurable outcomes in coordination with the Product Manager. * Provide technical guidance and hands-on support to Backend Engineers to ensure effective implementation and integration of AI capabilities. * Participate in technical planning, progress reviews, and regular evaluation of technical performance, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements. * Present experimentation findings, technical limitations, quality assessments, and recommendations to support the project's go/no-go decision and subsequent implementation. * Support technical reviews, User Acceptance Testing, knowledge transfer, and recommendations for future improvements or expansion of AI capabilities. **What You Will Need** ***Required Qualifications*** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * At least 5 (five) years of relevant professional experience in AI/ML, NLP, or software engineering, including hands-on development of AI-enabled applications. * Strong proficiency in Python and experience working with LLMs, Generative AI, and RAG-based applications. * Practical experience designing, developing, evaluating, and optimising AI pipelines, including retrieval, embedding, reranking, prompt engineering, and source-grounding techniques. * Experience assessing AI model performance and quality using appropriate automated evaluation methods, testing, and error analysis. * Experience integrating AI services into backend systems or production-oriented web applications through APIs or similar interfaces. * Understanding of multilingual NLP or machine translation, including challenges related to domain-specific terminology and translation accuracy. * Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. * Ability to communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly in English, both verbally and in writing. * Ability and willingness to travel when required. * Legally able to work in Indonesia. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * Experience developing multilingual AI applications for Southeast Asian languages or other low-resource languages. * Familiarity with AI evaluation tools and metrics such as RAGAS, BLEU, chrF++, BERTScore, or equivalent approaches. * Experience working with relevant AI frameworks, retrieval technologies, and infrastructure such as Hugging Face, PyTorch, FAISS, PostgreSQL, object storage, cloud services, or GPU-enabled environments. * Familiarity with responsible AI practices, source citation, human-in-the-loop validation, and AI-assisted document generation. **Performance Standard** * Provides technically sound and practical AI architecture and implementation recommendations aligned with the project's objectives, available resources, and agreed success criteria. * Demonstrates measurable progress in RAG retrieval, source grounding, and multilingual translation quality through documented and repeatable evaluations. * Delivers agreed AI technical components and evaluation results within the project scope, with recommendations supported by evidence and clearly documented limitations. * Ensures AI-generated content is evaluated for reliability, source traceability, and suitability for its intended use, with appropriate safeguards against unsupported outputs. * Collaborates effectively with the Product Manager and Backend Engineers, provides timely technical guidance, and communicates potential risks or delivery constraints. * Ensures AI components are appropriately tested, documented, maintainable, and ready for integration or handover, consistent with the project's go/no-go decision. **Duration** 15 November 2026 – 31 May 2027 **Deliverables** 1. Deliver one documented AI architecture and model comparison, including recommended technical approaches, model selection, evaluation criteria, and implementation considerations as a basis for go/no go process prior to the development process. 2. Develop and evaluate AI translation capabilities for two committed languages (Indonesian and one agreed additional Southeast Asian language), including an optimised RAG pipeline, source-grounding and citation-validation mechanisms, documented quality evaluations against the Phase 1 baseline, technical feasibility assessment, and a comprehensive technical handover package covering configurations, limitations, infrastructure costs, and recommendations for future development. 3. Deliver production-ready AI translation and content-generation components, including technical integration support, testing, and resolution of critical AI-related issues. **Terms of Payment** Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 18 (eighteen) working days per month on average. **How to Apply:** * Please submit a resume with a cover letter by **10 November 2026**. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates. * Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position. * Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed. * This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply. **What we offer:** * Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill. * Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia * Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields. * A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work * The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI * Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours **About Us:** World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations. **Our mission and values:** WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations. Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care. **Our culture:** WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status. Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications. #WRIIndonesia

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Flight TDM)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.13 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000402* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Flight TDM Engineering builds the systems that turn a stressful travel moment into a solved one. When a flight gets cancelled, rescheduled, or delayed across any of Traveloka's eleven markets, the platform you build is what reissues the ticket, calculates the refund, and tells a traveller exactly what happens next — in seconds, not hours. You will write the backend services and customer-facing interfaces that handle disruption at a scale few teams in Southeast Asia ever touch. jobs.title: Resident Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Role Summary:** ----------------- The Resident Incident Engineer is responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, resilience, and operational readiness of DDN storage infrastructure deployed within a customer / NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) environment. The role will initially support a mid-tier NCP deployment that is expected to grow into one of the largest storage environments in the region. The engineer will act as a trusted on-site technical resource, working closely with the customer’s infrastructure, platform, Kubernetes, networking, security, and operations teams. The role requires hands-on expertise across DDN storage platforms, EXAScaler/Lustre, Linux, high-speed networking, data-centre infrastructure, Kubernetes, and the Container Storage Interface (CSI). The engineer will provide proactive operational support, incident response, problem management, capacity planning, performance optimization, and technical coordination with DDN Support and Engineering. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Provide on-site operational ownership for DDN storage systems and associated EXAScaler/Lustre environments. * Monitor storage health, availability, capacity, performance, alerts, and system trends. * Respond to incidents, service requests, and operational events in accordance with agreed severity and response targets. * Lead technical triage, fault isolation, recovery, and root-cause analysis for storage, file-system, Linux, networking, and integration issues. * Coordinate with customer operations teams, DDN Support, Engineering, hardware vendors, and other stakeholders during major incidents. * Maintain and troubleshoot EXAScaler/Lustre file systems, metadata services, storage targets, client connectivity, failover, and recovery procedures. * Support Kubernetes environments that consume DDN storage, including cluster integration, persistent volumes, storage classes, access modes, and workloadlevel storage troubleshooting. * Configure, validate, and troubleshoot CSI drivers and related Kubernetes storage components Investigate issues across the Kubernetes-to-storage path, including pods, nodes, kubelet, CSI controller and node plugins, APIs, mounts, permissions, networking, and backend storage. * Support NFS, parallel file-system, block, and other storage access protocols where applicable. * Perform planned maintenance, upgrades, expansions, migrations, hardware replacements, and configuration changes using approved change-management processes. * Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, recovery procedures, escalation guides, and troubleshooting documentation. * Conduct regular health checks, capacity reviews, performance assessments, and operational-readiness reviews. * Identify risks, recurring failure patterns, single points of failure, and opportunities to improve reliability and automation. * Validate backup, restore, replication, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity procedures where applicable. * Support capacity forecasting for storage, metadata, network, client, and datagrowth requirements. * Assist with performance benchmarking, workload analysis, tuning, and servicelevel reporting. * Maintain accurate configuration management, asset records, incident records, problem records, and installed-base information. * Participate in on-call, out-of-hours, or escalation coverage as required by the customer environment. * Provide technical briefings, knowledge transfer, and operational training to customer teams. * Contribute to implementation schedules, risk and mitigation plans, acceptance testing, handover, and customer sign-off. **Required Qualifications and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. * At least 5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, storage administration, systems administration, data-centre operations, or a related field. * Hands-on experience supporting enterprise storage, HPC, AI, cloud, or highperformance computing environments. * Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills. +1.800.837.2298 · services@ddn.com · ddn.com * Experience with DDN storage platforms and/or EXAScaler/Lustre environments. * Experience with file systems such as Lustre, NFS, GPFS, or other parallel or distributed file systems. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes architecture and day-to-day cluster operations. * Working knowledge of the Container Storage Interface, including CSI controllers, node plugins, volume lifecycle operations, mounts, snapshots, expansion, and topology considerations. * Experience troubleshooting persistent storage consumed by Kubernetes workloads. * Strong understanding of IP networking, Ethernet, InfiniBand, or other high-speed interconnects. * Ability to interpret system logs, Kubernetes events, CSI logs, metrics, alerts, and performance data. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and alerting platforms. * Experience with incident management, problem management, change management, and technical escalation processes. * Ability to troubleshoot methodically across hardware, operating systems, storage, file systems, Kubernetes, networking, and application layers. * Strong understanding of data-centre fundamentals, including power, cooling, rack layouts, cabling, remote management, and hardware replacement procedures. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work independently on a customer site while collaborating effectively with distributed technical teams. * Willingness and ability to participate in on-call or after-hours support when required. **Desirable Skills:** --------------------- * Experience supporting large-scale or rapidly growing storage environments. * Experience with Kubernetes distributions such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, VMware Tanzu, or equivalent platforms. * Familiarity with Helm, Operators, Custom Resource Definitions, YAML, and Kubernetes troubleshooting tools. * Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, or comparable observability platforms. * Working knowledge of Ansible, Python, Bash, or other automation technologies. * Experience with Git-based configuration management and infrastructure-ascode practices. +1.800.837.2298 · services@ddn.com · ddn.com * Familiarity with S3 or object-storage concepts and data-movement tools. * Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos, and TLS certificates. * Knowledge of DNS, NTP, DHCP, routing, VLANs, MTU, firewall policies, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with high-availability design, quorum, failover, replication, and disaster recovery. * Familiarity with ITIL-based service management processes. * Experience preparing operational reports, service reviews, capacity forecasts, and executive summaries. * Relevant certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, cloud, networking, or storage. * Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese would be an advantage

jobs.title: Middle Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations * Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI * Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code * English — B1+ ### **Leadership Attributes** * Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches * Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed * Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested * Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team * Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them * Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer: * **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. * **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. * **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. * **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. * **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. jobs.descriptionText: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location** ------------ Batam **About this role** ------------------- The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web-based applications across both front-end and back-end systems. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** Bibit.id is a platform to help you to start your investment in mutual fund in a very simple way. **Job Description** We're currently looking for a top-notch full-stack developer to grow with our Developer team. Your primary focus will be on developing user interface components and implementing them following well-known React.js workflows. You will ensure that these components and the overall application are robust and easy to maintain. You will coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure. We're looking for someone who will constantly challenge themselves to be on the cutting-edge of new technology and grow the team's knowledge of best practices. We encourage sharing of ideas and feedback no matter who you are. **Work-Life Integration** We believe that having clear-thinking people will boost productivity. While working hard is important, we think it is important to avoid getting burnt out and value the need to have a fulfilling personal life.

jobs.title: Sales Project
jobs.descriptionHtml: Tentang Perusahaan PT Sinar Lampu Indonesia (Sanwa Group) Merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Lampu Hias, Perusahaan melayani kebutuhan pelanggan baik untuk proyek maupun konsumen, serta berhubungan dengan berbagai pihak seperti kontraktor, developer, dan pelanggan potensial. Ini adalah posisi Sales di bidang desain interior dan renovasi, dengan fokus pada mencari pelanggan baru, menjaga hubungan dengan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta mengelola proyek di sektor perumahan, komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan :** 1. Mencari pelanggan baru, mempertahankan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta melakukan follow-up terhadap proyek perumahan, lokasi komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. 2. Mengunjungi lokasi proyek, melakukan pengukuran, mencatat kondisi ruangan dan pekerjaan, membuat penawaran harga (quotation), serta menangani pesanan. 3. Melayani pelanggan di showroom/pameran, memberikan pelayanan, serta mendampingi pelanggan untuk melihat sampel dan memilih produk. 4. Melakukan follow-up terhadap proses produksi, pemasangan/instalasi, dan masalah setelah penjualan (after-sales), serta segera melaporkannya kepada manajemen. 5. Membuat laporan pekerjaan harian, termasuk follow-up pelanggan, kondisi lokasi proyek, pelanggan baru yang diperoleh, serta rencana pekerjaan untuk hari berikutnya. 6. Menjaga kerahasiaan informasi pelanggan, sistem harga, dan materi/produk perusahaan. **Kualifikasi Pekerjaan :** 1. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK. 2. Memiliki pengalaman 1–3 tahun di bidang sales, lebih disukai yang memiliki pengalaman di bidang interior. 3. Memahami penjualan B2B dan B2C serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. 4. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile/outdoor (banyak bekerja di lapangan). 5. Bersedia lembur apabila diperlukan. 6. Jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** VTL Travel is a Singapore-based travel company that operates as the parent brand for a family of niche travel sites, each targeting a distinct segment of the travel market. Under the VTL Travel umbrella sit three focused brands: Holidays From Singapore, which handles leisure travel, nearby getaways, cruises, visa-related services, and corporate trips; Tour Mount Bromo, which specializes in East Java tours covering Mount Bromo, Ijen, waterfalls, and private tour packages; and Batam Ferry Tickets, which focuses on Singapore-to-Batam ferry ticket bookings and promotions. **About the role** We're looking for a hands-on web developer to maintain and grow batamferrytickets.com — a custom built site — and to build and manage the API integrations that power our booking, payment, and ferry booking API features. This is a practical, execution-focused role: keeping the site fast, secure, and bug-free, while connecting it reliably to the third-party systems our bookings depend on. **Key responsibilities** * Maintain and troubleshoot website, including API Updates and theme updates, performance tuning, and uptime/security monitoring * Fix bugs, broken forms, layout issues, and mobile responsiveness problems as they arise * Implement design and content changes from the marketing team without breaking page speed or SEO structure * Manage staging-to-live deployment workflow to avoid downtime on a revenue-generating site * Build and maintain the integration between the site and the ferry ticketing/booking system (availability, pricing, seat/ticket confirmation) * Develop and maintain the hotel-booking module integration for combined ferry+hotel packages (hotel supplier or OTA API/feed) * Maintain the payment gateway integration (HitPay or Airwallex) and troubleshoot failed or stuck transactions * Connect and maintain WhatsApp Business API or click-to-WhatsApp flows for enquiry handling * Set up and maintain GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking (events, server-side tagging where needed) so booking data flows correctly for marketing reporting * Handle webhook endpoints and scheduled sync jobs (e.g. inventory/price sync) reliably, with logging and error alerts **About you** * 2+ years of experience Web Developer (PHP, custom functions, child themes, Payment Gateway Integration) * Proven experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs, handling JSON, authentication (API keys, OAuth), and webhooks * Good Practical skillset in API integration * Experience with payment gateway integrations (HitPay, Stripe, PayNow, or similar) * Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads conversion tracking * Solid understanding of website security (SSL, backups, firewall rules, malware cleanup) * Familiar with git-based deployment workflows and staging environments * Able to debug independently and document fixes clearly Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst – Banking Industry
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi:** * Minimal **S1** dari jurusan **Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Manajemen, Ekonomi, atau bidang terkait**. * Memiliki **pengalaman kerja minimal 5 tahun** sebagai **Business Analyst** di industri **perbankan** (retail, corporate, digital banking, atau core banking system). * Memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang **proses bisnis perbankan** seperti: * Core Banking System (Deposit, Loan, Payment, GL, CIF) * Digital Banking (Mobile Banking, Internet Banking) * Regulatory Reporting (BI-FAST, LLDIKTI, OJK, dsb.) * Mampu melakukan **analisis kebutuhan bisnis dan sistem (BRD, FSD, SRS)**. * Berpengalaman dalam **koordinasi dengan user, vendor, dan tim teknis (developer, tester, infra)**. * Mampu melakukan **gathering requirement, mapping proses bisnis, dan gap analysis**. * Memiliki kemampuan dalam **dokumentasi proses bisnis, workflow, dan use case diagram** (menggunakan tools seperti Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart, atau BPMN). * Terbiasa dengan **metodologi SDLC / Agile Scrum**. * Memiliki kemampuan **komunikasi, koordinasi, dan presentasi** yang baik. * Detail-oriented, analitis, dan mampu bekerja mandiri maupun dalam tim. **Scope of Work:** * Melakukan **analisis kebutuhan bisnis** dari stakeholder dan memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan tujuan proyek. * Membuat **Business Requirement Document (BRD)** dan berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis untuk menyusun **Functional Specification Document (FSD)**. * Melakukan **analisis gap** antara kebutuhan bisnis dengan sistem yang ada. * Mendukung proses **UAT (User Acceptance Test)** termasuk penyusunan test scenario dan verifikasi hasil. * Melakukan **koordinasi dengan user bisnis, tim IT, dan vendor eksternal** terkait pengembangan dan implementasi sistem. * Memberikan **rekomendasi solusi bisnis dan sistem** yang efektif untuk mendukung efisiensi operasional perbankan. * Membuat **laporan perkembangan proyek** secara berkala kepada manajemen. * Mendukung proses **improvement sistem dan kebijakan operasional** sesuai kebutuhan regulator (OJK, BI, dll). **Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have):** * Memiliki pengalaman dengan **project BI-FAST, SNAP, ISO 20022, Core Banking Migration**, atau sistem **Digital Channel Banking**. * Familiar dengan **SQL query, data mapping, atau basic data analytics**. * Memiliki **sertifikasi CBAP, ECBA, atau Agile Business Analyst** menjadi nilai tambah. Jika Anda cocok dengan posisi dan industri yang disebutkan di atas atau memiliki referensi untuk kandidat yang sesuai, silakan hubungi kami WA: 087777686171 Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Pertanyaan Lamaran: * berapa Usia Anda? * Apakahkamu Familiar dengan SQL query, data mapping, atau basic data analytics.? * Apakah kamu Memiliki pengalaman dengan project BI-FAST, SNAP, ISO 20022, Core Banking Migration, atau sistem Digital Channel Banking.? Pendidikan: * S1 (Diwajibkan) Pengalaman: * IT Bisnis Analys: 5 tahun (Diwajibkan) Bahasa: * English (Diutamakan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Salesforce / CRM Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **SoftwareSeni** is a Software Development Company based in Yogyakarta & Sydney, Australia. We have been designing and developing phone apps, websites, and mobile experiences. We love solving tough problems – from user experience to design and code. We build enterprise web-based solutions for clients all over the world, from Australia, Indonesia, Europe, Africa, and America. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, and Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more. **What will you get?** * **Competitive Salary**. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep employees in the company, therefore, we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff. * **Career Development & Training**. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work. * **Reasonable & Flexible Schedules**. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool. * **English Class**. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you will get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written, guaranteed! * **Annual Leave Entitlement**. 12 working days, which can be taken after 3 months of joining. * **Performance Review**. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day. * **Relocation Allowance**. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family. * **Staff Engagement Activities**. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right? * **Birthday Leave**. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them a half-day leave on their birthday. **Requirements:** * Relevant Degrees (Associate Degree and/or Bachelor Degree) * Minimum of **3 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development, customization, or configuration.** * **Experience configuring and customizing Salesforce functionality to support business requirements.** * Familiarity with Salesforce objects, fields, validation rules, flows, automation, data models, relationships, and business logic. * Working knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), or Visualforce is an advantage. * Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, and data flows between Salesforce, ERP systems, websites, and middleware is a plus. * Knowledge of CRM concepts and business processes, including lead-to-opportunity workflows and account and contact management. * Experience with testing, debugging, and Salesforce deployment processes. * Strong interest in developing Salesforce development and integration expertise, with a willingness to learn about multi-system environments and business processes. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Detail-oriented and systematic approach to development and system configuration. * Good communication and interpersonal skills. * **Possess strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.** * **Willing to work onsite in Semarang office.** **Responsibilities:** * Salesforce development: Develop and customize Salesforce functionality, including objects, fields, validation rules, flows, and automation. * Custom development: Contribute to Salesforce custom development using technologies such as Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), or Visualforce, where applicable. * Business logic: Implement CRM workflows, including lead-to-opportunity processes and account and contact management. * Data management: Maintain Salesforce data models, relationships, and data integrity. * System integrations: Develop and maintain API integrations between Salesforce and external systems, including ERP systems, websites, and middleware. * Testing and debugging: Test and troubleshoot Salesforce functionality and integrations. * Deployment and documentation: Support Salesforce deployments and maintain technical documentation. * **Note: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English**. If you're confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit. **Disclaimer:** By submitting your application, you consent to PT Software Services Indonesia collecting and processing your information for recruitment purposes. **Please submit only your CV/resume at this stage; do not attach additional personal identification or sensitive documents.** Your details will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

jobs.title: [Internship] Tech Microdemy
jobs.descriptionHtml: Timedoor is a Bali-based IT company providing services in website, mobile app, and system development, online marketing, graphic design, and AI system integration. We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our internship program as an **Intern Tech Microdemy**. This role offers an opportunity to gain practical experience in IT issue management, technical documentation, and cross-functional collaboration. **Job Description** * Receive and record issue and bug reports from Customer Service and branch teams through Plane. * Classify and prioritize reported issues, perform initial issue reproduction, and escalate findings to the Project Manager or Developer when necessary. * Handle data export requests from internal systems. * Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly issue reports. * Monitor recurring issues and communicate potential problems or patterns to the Project Manager. * Document resolved issues to support the team's knowledge base and improve internal processes. **Qualifications** * Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree or holding a bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * Understanding of information systems fundamentals, web application workflows, and basic Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum or Sprint methodologies and collaboration tools such as Slack and Plane is an advantage. * Experience in IT projects or organizations involving technical documentation and cross-functional coordination is a plus. * Good communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. * Willing to work on-site in Bali and able to provide a personal laptop for internship activities. **Benefits** * Hands-on experience with real IT operations and issue management. * Mentoring and guidance from experienced team members. * Pocket money during the internship. * Internship certificate upon successful completion of the program. Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: REQUIREMENTS - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, IT, or a related field. - Minimum 3 years of experience in software development, with prior Team Lead or Supervisory experience being a plus. - Proficient in Laravel, Flutter, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, REST API, and MySQL. - Proven experience in end-to-end project development, with strong knowledge of SDLC, system analysis, database design, GitHub, and software development processes. - Portfolio of self-developed web and/or mobile applications is mandatory. jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.23 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000418* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical. Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in. As a DevSecOps Engineer, you are the technical authority for security within the software development lifecycle, driving the most complex security-in-pipeline programs, setting the standards your function operates by, and shaping how secure development is practiced across Traveloka as an individual contributor. **Job Scope:** * Own and drive the most complex, highest-impact SDLC security programs end-to-end, from scoping and embedding controls into CI/CD workflows through to remediation validation and organisational learning * Define and enforce the technical standards, scanning methodologies, and tooling frameworks your function operates by — covering vulnerability detection in code and 3rd-party libraries — ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous improvement across all security work in the build pipeline * Identify systemic gaps in secure coding practice and pipeline security coverage across the engineering organisation, and lead cross-functional improvement programs that produce lasting structural change in how Traveloka builds software securely * Act as the senior technical authority in security discussions with engineering, product, and business leadership, providing the depth of reasoning and credibility that helps the organisation make sound, defensible decisions on security rules and build-time controls * Influence engineering teams toward secure coding and design practices through deep technical credibility, shaping how security is embedded into Traveloka’s development workflows as an individual contributor * Define how AI tools are adopted within secure development workflows, establishing the standards for responsible use and modeling the judgment that separates genuine security acceleration from risk amplification * Define and own Traveloka’s CI/CD pipeline security architecture, setting the standards for how security controls are embedded across build workflows and ensuring coverage is consistent, reliable, and trusted by the engineering organisation * Lead the design and delivery of the most complex security automation and tooling programs, producing capabilities that scale security feedback across hundreds of engineers and measurably improve secure development practices * Shape Traveloka’s secure development culture at an organisational level, defining the security awareness strategy and developer guidance frameworks that make security a natural part of how engineering teams build **Requirements:** * You have at least 6 years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, application security, or secure SDLC engineering * Designs and builds production-grade security tooling and automation (e.g. CI/CD security scanners, SCA/SAST integrations, policy-as-code) in Python or equivalent * You have defined security standards or built security capabilities — such as vulnerability scanning, dependency/3rd-party library checks, or security rule validation — adopted across an entire engineering organisation * You have driven the change management required to make them stick, including getting developer teams to adopt secure coding guidance during the build process * You can weigh security, operational, and business trade-offs in your decisions and defend them with data, communicating clearly to both technical and business leadership * You influence senior engineers and cross-functional leaders through credibility rather than authority * You use AI security tools with sophistication, understanding their failure modes and shaping how they are adopted responsibly within developer workflows * You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field * You are the security engineer that engineering directors want in the room for the most consequential CI/CD and secure development architecture decisions * You have defined pipeline security architecture at organizational scale and built security automation that measurably improved secure coding practices across hundreds of engineers **Join Us** If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you. We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days. We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** FINNS Beach Club is looking for a talented individual who is passionate about digital design, user experience, and visual craftsmanship. We are currently seeking a UI/UX Designer to join our growing marketing team and shape the digital presence of one of the world’s most iconic destinations. **Summary** FINNS World's Best Beach Club is not just a beach club; it's a destination where dreams come alive! We pride ourselves on creating exhilarating entertainment, vibrant energy, and unforgettable F&B experiences. Nestled along the breathtaking Bali coastline, we provide a one-of-a-kind party atmosphere that leaves our guests craving for more. **Responsibilities** * Craft intuitive, engaging, and visually stunning user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, bringing unique brand campaigns to life with strong visual craftsmanship. * Build, expand, and maintain scalable Design Systems and component libraries to ensure visual consistency across all digital touchpoints. * Collaborate closely with Web Developers, Marketing teams, and various departments across FINNS to ensure seamless design handoffs and technical feasibility. * Analyse feedback, analytics, and UI/UX trends to continually optimise digital journeys and conversion rates. * Establish design standards, guidelines, and best practices for the company's digital ecosystem. **Qualifications** * Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role. * Strong written and spoken communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Strong mastery of Figma, including advanced features such as Design Tokens, Auto-Layout, Components, and Prototyping. * Proven hands-on experience in building, documenting, and managing Design Systems and component libraries (Figma, tokens, auto-layout, etc.). * Solid understanding of user-centred design principles and responsive web design. * Basic-to-intermediate understanding of UX Writing, with the ability to write functional copy. * Basic understanding of HTML/CSS capabilities and technical constraints for smooth dev-handoffs. * Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design sense, end-to-end UX processes, and design system. * Excellent problem-solving skills, visual accuracy, and strong attention to detail. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * ) Create and adjust source code according to user stories, and acceptance criteria (requirements) that have been submitted by the Product Owner, coordinate and collaborate with fellow Scrum teams and tech leads regarding the tasks to be carried out * ) Take a task in the Kanban tools project management (todo status) and update the status to progress when it is being worked on, inform what obstacles need to be supported from the task at the daily scrum meeting, and coordinate with the Tech/App Leader on the task being worked on until the task is completed. * ) get feedback from the tester/QA regarding the task, coordinate with the tester/QA regarding existing bugs, and make improvements so that the task can be delivered * ) Update the source code that is being worked on so that it has a good score regarding security concerns (sonarqube) and has a structured log format that is easy to understand and search * ) Make regular improvements regarding bugs that occur and prioritize fixing blocking processes * ) Supporting the required technical documentation **Requirements** Java, Springboot Node JS Python Message Broker(RabbitMQ/Kafka), Redis RDBMS(MySQL/Postgre) NoSQL(MongoDB/Elasticsearch) HTML, CSS, Flutter RestAPI, Socket, XML/SOAP, OpenAPI/Swagger **About Akulaku Group** Akulaku is a leading banking and digital finance platform in Southeast Asia, with a presence in Indonesia, the Philippines, and Malaysia. In addition to the Akulaku virtual credit card and ecommerce platform, the company operates Asetku, an online wealth management platform and Neobank, a mobile digital bank supported by Bank Neo Commerce. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About The Role** The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team. **What You Will Do** * Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments. * Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads. * Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them. * Diagnose and resolve database performance issues. * Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents. * Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders. * Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders. * Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer (SDE 3)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kredivo Group is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to lead day-to-day Enterprise Security work. This is a hands-on role. You will own the security of our endpoints, identity, SaaS, network and cloud, and you will guide junior security engineers on the team. You will deploy and run our security platforms, remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet, and harden our corporate environment using zero trust and secure-by-default principles. You will work with IT, DevOps and Engineering across Indonesia, and international, and support Cyber Defense during incidents. **About the Job**: Cyber Defense Strategy & Leadership * Enterprise Security BAU work and projects, and help set the team's roadmap. * Mentor and coach SDE-1 and SDE-2 engineers, and review their configurations, scripts and remediation work. * Set priorities by risk, and track and report security posture metrics (patch compliance, EDR coverage, vulnerability SLA, phishing click rate) to the Enterprise Security Lead. * Write, maintain and enforce IT and Security policies, standards and procedures. Endpoint, Vulnerability & Patch Management * Administer and tune the security platforms: EDR, VMDR, WAF and the Email Security Gateway. * Run vulnerability management end to end: scanning, prioritization (CVSS, CISA KEV, Ransomware), remediation and SLA tracking across Windows, macOS and Linux. * Build and safely deploy patch and remediation automation through MDM tools. * Keep endpoint security agents deployed and healthy across the fleet. Identity, SaaS & Cloud Hardening * Work with IT and DevOps to harden Cloud Directory, Google Workspace, VPN and other SaaS tools. * Design and review IAM controls: SSO (SAML, OAuth/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, MFA, conditional access, least privilege and access reviews. * Apply zero trust and secure-by-default models in architecture decisions for knowledge workers and developers. * Monitoring & Incident Support, Monitor internal and external systems for threats, triage alerts, and respond to them. * Support Cyber Defense during incidents with containment actions such as isolation, account suspension and blocking. * Run phishing simulations and security awareness programs, and measure the results. * Advise employees on how to keep endpoints, office AV and network infrastructure secure. * Automate security operations and reporting using Python, Bash or PowerShell. * Evaluate new security tools, including AI-assisted tools, and support AI Security initiatives. * Support ISO 27001:2022 and regulatory audits (e.g. OJK) by providing evidence, remediating gaps and maintaining controls. **About You:** * At least 5 years of cyberdefense security experience, preferably in a startup or fintech environment. * Hands-on experience deploying and managing EDR, vulnerability and patch management, DLP, network security and phishing simulation tools. * Strong knowledge of identity and access management frameworks and protocols (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM). * Experience securing Google Workspace, directory services, VPN and SaaS platforms. * Experience with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP). * Good scripting skills (Python, Bash or PowerShell). * Knowledge of modern adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (MITRE ATT&CK). * Experience mentoring engineers or leading small workstreams or projects. * Good English communication skills. #LI-AF1

Scrum Master, Product Owner, atau Agile Project Manager menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami siklus pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC) dan DevOps Lifecycle. * Berpengalaman menggunakan tools manajemen proyek Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project dan Trello / Asana. * Memahami konsep Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), dan Generative AI. * Memiliki pengalaman memimpin implementasi salah satu atau lebih teknologi seperti AI Chatbot, Large Language Models (LLM), Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) dan Intelligent Automation. * platform cloud seperti Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML Services dan Google Cloud AI. * Memiliki kemampuan dalam penyusunan seperti Project Charter, Business Requirement Document manajemen risiko, kualitas, perubahan (Change Management), serta tata kelola proyek IT. * Memiliki kemampuan stakeholder management dan executive reporting yang baik. * Memahami prinsip keamanan informasi, data privacy, dan AI Governance. jobs.title: IT Programmer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Why Join Us** --------------- ### **Learn, Experiment, Repeat** Problem-solving culture with continuous learning in cloud and DevOps. ### **Open Culture, Smart Collaboration** We value transparency, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful collaboration. ### **Shape Your Career Path** We provide mentorship to shape your path in IT and leadership. ### **IT Programmer** Engineering • Jabodetabek Apply Now We are currently hiring for an IT Programmer position. If you have a foundational understanding of the Linux operating system and experience working with data, such as using SQL, please review the full requirements below and join our team. #### **Job Description** * Work on-site in a 24/7 environment, organized into three shifts per day. * Responsible for system monitoring and basic troubleshooting in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Assist the L0 IT Helpdesk team in performing simple troubleshooting and reconfiguring digital systems and services. * Coordinate with the engineering team regarding system troubleshooting and reconfiguration. * Ensure the reliability, availability, and success rate of services meet established targets. * Must be willing to work within the banking sector. #### **Requirements** * Minimum education: Diploma 3 (D3) degree. * Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. * Proficient in at least one programming language. * Possess strong soft skills, demonstrated by initiative and a high drive to work and learn. * Basic knowledge of the Linux operating system (holding an LFCA certification is an advantage). * Understanding of how to store, manage, and retrieve data using SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases. * Basic knowledge of public cloud/IaaS management is an advantage. * Internal certifications or equivalent training aligned with the Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS) syllabus are an advantage.

jobs.title: Data & AI Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world. Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible. **Team Description:** You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which powers analytics, data science and AI tooling across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace to our OTA business, in markets worldwide. Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the data ingestion, platform and AI tooling work behind them. **The Role:** You will build and operate the ingestion systems and runtime infrastructure that support analytics, data science and AI tools across Wego. Your focus is reliable data movement from source systems and dependable operation of the services that consume it, and you will own pipelines and services through development, deployment and operation. You'll work closely with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to find bottlenecks and build practical solutions, and you'll connect AI tools to data and services with clear access boundaries, evaluations and operational ownership. **What you will be working on:** * Building reliable batch and streaming pipelines so data moves from source systems without being silently lost or duplicated * Running pipelines and services on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, with repeatable environments and safe release and rollback paths * Building the systems that let AI assistants and agents use Wego data and APIs reliably, with evaluations built alongside data scientists * Improving reliability and cloud cost against agreed service goals * Finding sources of data loss, operational toil and slow delivery, validating their impact with users and owning the fix end to end **Core Responsibilities:** * Data ingestion: Build pipelines from APIs, databases and event sources; handle schema changes, incremental loads and change data capture where needed * Recovery & data quality: Design retries, deduplication, backfills and replay; monitor freshness and completeness from source to consumer * Kubernetes & runtime: Deploy and operate containerized pipelines and services; manage resources, configuration, scaling and recovery with platform teams * DevOps & delivery: Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines; test changes and manage secrets and access * Observability & operations: Define metrics, logs and alerts; diagnose incidents and fix recurring failures * AI tooling & model services: Build tool and API integrations, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, prompts and guardrails; support model serving where needed * Evaluations: Build test sets, regression checks and monitoring of AI outputs with data scientists **Skills and experience:** * 3–8 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering or related infrastructure work * Experience owning ingestion systems in production, including failures, recovery and source schema changes * Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and cloud infrastructure * Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments and infrastructure as code * Fluency in Python and SQL, with practical Linux, networking and container skills * Experience with APIs, databases and event systems, including batch or streaming ingestion * Understanding of delivery guarantees, idempotency and schema compatibility, and how they affect downstream data * Experience with Kubernetes and container tooling such as Docker and Helm * Experience with a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS, and infrastructure tools such as Terraform * Practical knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring, alerting and incident diagnosis * Ability to build AI assistants and agents (tool calling, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, guardrails) and evaluate them with test sets and regression checks * You spot worthwhile problems without waiting to be assigned, validate why they matter and own the solution through to measurable impact * You align priorities with stakeholders, then work independently through ambiguity and missing context * You use AI fluently but own the output: you test generated code, investigate failure paths and own what you deploy * You provide tests and operational evidence before calling a change complete, and fix defects after release * You explain engineering tradeoffs in practical terms and treat analysts, data scientists and product teams as users of what you build **Additional Info:** * Experience building AI assistants, agents, evaluations or model services is a plus * Travel-domain experience is a plus

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** Kami mencari **DevSecOps Engineer** yang tangguh untuk membangun, mengamankan, dan mengotomatiskan jalur rilis serta infrastruktur aplikasi berbasis *container* di PT Mitra Cakra Digital. Di peran ini, Anda adalah garda terdepan yang memastikan sistem kami beroperasi secara stabil, aman, dan *high-availability*. Hasil kerja Anda—mulai dari *pipeline* CI/CD, otomatisasi GitOps, hingga *observability stack*—akan menjadi fondasi utama yang diandalkan oleh seluruh tim pengembang kami. **Apa yang akan Anda OpenTelemetry**. * Mahir dalam **Docker** beserta penerapan praktik *container security hardening*. **Soft Skill unggulan:** Memiliki kesadaran tinggi bahwa infrastruktur yang dibangun adalah fondasi Snyk) ke dalam *pipeline*. * Pengalaman kerja di lingkungan IT Consulting atau *System Integrator*. **Skema Bekerja:** **On-Site** **(Work From Office)** -- Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Bogor Regency. Di sini, tim didorong untuk bereksperimen, selalu mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital adalah pemberi kerja yang berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan. Seluruh kandidat dinilai berdasarkan kompetensi dan kesesuaian dengan peran. Work Location: In person

You will act as the technical bridge between customers and our regional/HQ team, supporting the sales cycle with technical solutions in the Kubernetes, container platform, and DevOps space. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide customers with on-site guidance and training for product trials, help customers solve technical problems, become a technical communication bridge between customers and the company, and maintain good customer relations. * Cooperate with the sales team to identify business opportunities, provide solutions and pre-sales technical support.
