jobs.title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations. This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction. You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle. A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure. You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization. **What You’ll Own** **Identity, Access & Credential Security** * Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems. * Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets. * Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding. * Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts. * Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence. **Security Monitoring & Incident Response** * Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints. * Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure. * Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks. * Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials. **Internal Systems & Workforce Security** * Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems. * Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations. * Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials. **What We’re Looking For** * 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role. * Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing. * Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management. * Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Strong understanding of Linux access, SSH, VPN, endpoints, cloud/SaaS administration, email security, and remote-workforce security. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to enforce security controls while collaborating with HR, IT, managers, and system owners. **Preferred Background** Experience in web hosting, cloud infrastructure, data centers, SaaS, fintech, MSSP, or another distributed technology environment is highly valuable. Preferred certifications include Security+, CySA+, GCIH, SC-200, IAM/PAM vendor certifications, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are a plus — hands-on experience matters more. **What Success Looks Like** **You will help us improve:** * MFA and privileged-access coverage * Joiner/mover/leaver security and access-removal speed * Control of shared, dormant, and excessive access * Alert response and incident-resolution times * Access-review coverage and security evidence * Internal security standards, procedures, and playbooks **Important** We are not looking for a policy/compliance-only profile. The successful candidate must have real hands-on experience administering access controls, operating security tooling, investigating logs, and responding to security incidents. You will work closely with our second cybersecurity specialist, the Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer, as well as DevOps, Network, Product, Engineering, Support, Abuse, HR, Finance, Legal, and executive management. If you enjoy taking ownership, building security controls, investigating real incidents, and improving security in a large-scale technology environment, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** ------------------ Accenture is seeking talented ServiceNow Engineers to join our growing Technology team. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about digital workflow automation, IT Service Management (ITSM), and enterprise platform development. As a ServiceNow Engineer, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, develop, enhance, and support ServiceNow solutions that improve operational efficiency, employee experience, and business service delivery. You will have the opportunity to work on enterprise-scale implementations while building expertise across various ServiceNow products and modules. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, configure, develop, and maintain ServiceNow applications and workflows in alignment with business and technical requirements. * Build and enhance solutions across ServiceNow modules such as IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Customer Service Management (CSM), and Service Catalog. * Develop custom applications, integrations, scripts, workflows, business rules, UI policies, client scripts, and automation solutions on the ServiceNow platform. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, solution architects, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable platform solutions. * Support system integration activities with enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and third-party tools. * Participate in system testing, defect resolution, deployment, and production support activities. * Troubleshoot technical issues and perform root cause analysis to ensure platform stability and optimal performance. * + Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, platform governance, and ServiceNow best practices. + Prepare and maintain technical documentation, configuration guides, and knowledge transfer materials. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 1-5 years of experience in ServiceNow development, administration, implementation, or support. * Hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform configuration and development. * Knowledge of JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, integrations, web technologies, and workflow automation concepts. * Understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Service Request Management, and CMDB concepts. * Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or DevOps delivery environments. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. * Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in one or more ServiceNow modules, including: + ITSM + ITOM + ITAM + HRSD + CSM + GRC/IRM + Service Portal + Integration Hub * ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification. * ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification. * Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Discovery, Event Management, or CMDB implementation. * Familiarity with cloud technologies, automation tools, and enterprise application integrations. * Exposure to ITIL framework and IT service management best practices. **Career Growth Opportunities** ------------------------------- As part of Accenture's global ServiceNow practice, you will have opportunities to: * Work on enterprise-scale digital transformation projects. * Gain certifications across ServiceNow technologies and emerging platform capabilities. * Collaborate with global delivery teams and industry experts. * Progress toward Senior Analyst, Consultant, and Specialist career tracks within Accenture Technology. **About the Company / Team** ---------------------------- We work with one shared purpose: to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Every day, more than 775,000 of us help our stakeholders continuously reinvent. Together, we drive positive change and deliver value to our clients, partners, shareholders, communities, and each other. We believe that delivering value requires innovation, and innovation thrives in an inclusive and diverse environment. We actively foster a workplace free from bias, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is respected and empowered to do their best work. At Accenture, we see well-being holistically, supporting our people's physical, mental, and financial health. We also provide opportunities to keep skills relevant through certifications, learning, and diverse work experiences. We're proud to be consistently recognized as one of the World's Best Workplaces™. Join Accenture to work at the heart of change. Visit us at www.accenture.com. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Accenture is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Cloud and Platform Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About Amartha** Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth. Our Empowered to Grow culture guides how we work together. We Focus on Clarity, Take the Lead, and Grow Impact, empowering our people to take ownership and create meaningful, lasting impact. ### **About the role** Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. Our production platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes, and our security team is building the controls, detection, and automation that a regulated lender needs at that scale. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own cloud and platform security engineering. You will run the controls that detect and prevent misconfiguration and intrusion across our cloud and container estate, respond to what our detection stack surfaces, and turn manual security infrastructure into code. You will work alongside DevOps and platform engineering, and your work feeds directly into our ISO 27001 and regulator audit evidence. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a wide mandate. You will be the senior voice on cloud security in the team, and we expect you to set the technical direction for it rather than wait for a backlog. ### **What you will do** * Own container and cloud runtime security: workload isolation, Kubernetes hardening, and runtime threat detection. * Run and extend automated benchmark and configuration scanning across our cloud platform and productivity suite, and act on what it finds. * Build shift-left security into CI/CD: infrastructure-as-code scanning and misconfiguration gates before deployment. * Bring the security team's own cloud estate under infrastructure as code. Provisioning is manual and drift-prone today, and ending that is a named deliverable of this role. * Build and run the deployment pipeline for our security tooling, so security infrastructure ships the same way the product does. * Own the SIEM platform end to end: network isolation, version currency, configuration management, and detection coverage across critical workloads. * Respond to and review security alerts, tune detection rules, and cut false positives. * Manage edge and perimeter security: web application firewall rules, DNS and traffic visibility, and security event retention. * Manage the platform and console access paths that sit with security engineering. * Document what you build, to the standard where another engineer can operate it without you. jobs.title: Laboratory Analyst (Engineering - Water Plant Management)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * Mengelola operasional laboratorium serta memastikan seluruh kegiatan berjalan sesuai standar. * Menyusun jadwal dan mengoordinasikan pengujian kualitas air minum dan air limbah. * Menyusun dan mengevaluasi SOP serta metode pengujian laboratorium. * Mengelola kebutuhan laboratorium, termasuk anggaran, reagen, dan peralatan. * Melakukan monitoring kualitas air serta mendukung implementasi standar ZDHC. * Menyusun dan memberikan pelatihan terkait laboratorium, pengambilan sampel, kalibrasi alat, dan keselamatan kerja. * Berkoordinasi dengan laboratorium eksternal terkait pengambilan sampel, pengujian, dan verifikasi hasil analisis. * Melakukan review terhadap hasil analisis laboratorium, termasuk laporan ZDHC dan PDAM. **Requirements** * Pendidikan minimal S1 Chemical Engineer, Environment Engineer atau bidang terkait. * Minimal pengalaman di laboratorium pengujian/kalibrasi minimal 3 tahun. * Memiliki pengalaman memimpin tim minimal 2 tahun. * Memiliki pengalaman melakukan analisis parameter air minum dan air limbah minimal 2 tahun. * Memahami manajemen laboratorium, kalibrasi, validasi, dan verifikasi metode pengujian. * Memahami standar ZDHC dan pengujian mikrobiologi menjadi nilai tambah. * Mampu mengoperasikan komputer serta melakukan analisis data. * Memiliki kemampuan analisis, presentasi, komunikasi, dan penyusunan laporan yang baik. * Mampu bekerja sama dengan baik dalam tim maupun lintas departemen. **About Pou Chen Group Indonesia** Pou Chen Group, the largest branded athletic and casual footwear manufacturer in the world, is an OEM/ODM for major international brand name companies such as Nike, Adidas, Asics, New Balance, Timberland, and Salomon. As a global leader in the manufacture of branded athletic and casual/outdoor footwear, the Group produced 238.3 million pairs of shoes last year. Founded in Taiwan, Pou Chen Group currently has its manufacturing factories and retailing sites throughout Taiwan, China, Indonesia, Vietnam, and other areas in Asia. Our vision is to benefit healthy lives by providing the most valuable solutions in the sports industry and beyond. We commit ourselves to provide the best services and products supported by technology-based solutions to be the most valuable platform steered by smart manufacturing and innovative services.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager - PT Integra Teknologi Solusi
jobs.descriptionHtml: Deskripsi Pekerjaan **.custom\_\_ql-container a { text-decoration:** underline !important; } Kami mencari Associate Product Manager (APM) yang akan membantu pengembangan dan peningkatan produk persuratan digital di PT Integra Teknologi Solusi. Pada posisi ini, Anda tidak hanya berfokus pada pengembangan fitur, tetapi juga diharapkan mampu memahami kebutuhan pengguna, proses bisnis, dan dampak produk terhadap revenue serta pertumbuhan bisnis. Anda akan berkolaborasi dengan tim Engineering, QA, UI/UX, Operations, Sales/Business Development, serta stakeholder eksternal untuk memastikan produk memiliki value yang kuat bagi pengguna sekaligus mendukung tujuan bisnis perusahaan. **.custom\_\_ql-container a { text-decoration:** underline !important; } Tanggung Jawab Membantu Product Manager dalam menyusun product roadmap, prioritas fitur, dan product backlog berdasarkan kebutuhan pengguna dan prioritas bisnis. Menggali kebutuhan pengguna dan stakeholder untuk memahami proses persuratan serta menemukan peluang pengembangan produk. Menyusun PRD, user story, acceptance criteria, dan dokumentasi produk lainnya. Berkolaborasi dengan Engineering, QA, dan UI/UX selama proses pengembangan hingga release. Menganalisis proses surat masuk, surat keluar, disposisi, approval, dan pengarsipan untuk mengidentifikasi peluang improvement. Mengidentifikasi peluang produk yang dapat meningkatkan customer value, product adoption, retention, dan revenue. Berkolaborasi dengan Sales/Business Development untuk memahami kebutuhan pasar dan menerjemahkannya menjadi peluang pengembangan produk. Memahami dampak pengembangan fitur terhadap revenue, customer acquisition, retention, operational cost, dan business efficiency. Mendukung proses UAT bersama stakeholder terkait. Melakukan monitoring performa produk pasca-release dan mengevaluasi apakah fitur memberikan impact sesuai objective yang ditetapkan. Menggunakan data dan product metrics sebagai dasar dalam mengevaluasi performa produk dan menentukan prioritas improvement. Area Produk yang Akan Ditangani Surat Masuk & Surat Keluar Disposisi Surat Approval & Workflow Persuratan Digital Signature / Tanda Tangan Elektronik Template & Penomoran Surat Manajemen Dokumen & Arsip Digital Tracking & Monitoring Surat Notifikasi Persuratan Role & Access Management Dashboard & Reporting **.custom\_\_ql-container a { text-decoration:** underline !important; } Kualifikasi Wajib Pengalaman 1–3 tahun sebagai Associate Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, System Analyst, atau posisi serupa. Memahami Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) dan proses pengembangan produk digital. Terbiasa menyusun requirement, user story, acceptance criteria, dan dokumentasi produk. Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan problem solving yang baik. Mampu menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis dan pengguna menjadi solusi produk yang terstruktur. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan stakeholder management yang baik. Memiliki business acumen dan memahami hubungan antara product, customer value, dan revenue. Mampu menentukan prioritas berdasarkan kombinasi user impact, business impact, effort, dan urgency. Nilai Tambah Memiliki pengalaman di industri SaaS, enterprise software, document management, digital government, atau workflow management. Memahami konsep Document Management System (DMS), workflow, digital archive, dan electronic document. Pernah terlibat dalam pengembangan produk yang memiliki commercial/business target. Memahami product metrics seperti adoption, activation, retention, conversion, revenue, dan customer lifetime value. Memahami dasar SQL dan data analysis. Memahami API & system integration. Terbiasa menggunakan Jira, Confluence, Figma, Draw.io, atau tools product management lainnya. Pernah berkolaborasi dengan Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, atau Commercial team. Kriteria Kandidat Ideal Product-minded & business-minded — tidak hanya bertanya "fitur apa yang harus dibuat?", tetapi juga "masalah apa yang diselesaikan dan apa impact-nya terhadap bisnis?" Memiliki rasa ingin tahu tinggi terhadap kebutuhan dan pain point pengguna. Mampu melihat hubungan antara product improvement, customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, dan revenue. Detail-oriented dalam menyusun requirement, namun tetap mampu melihat big picture. Memiliki ownership kuat terhadap product delivery dan outcome. Mampu berpikir sistematis dalam memahami proses bisnis dan workflow yang kompleks. Nyaman berkomunikasi dengan stakeholder teknis, bisnis, maupun customer. Terbiasa mengambil keputusan berdasarkan data, customer insight, business impact, dan product strategy. Memiliki commercial awareness dan tertarik memahami bagaimana produk dapat menciptakan dan meningkatkan revenue. Tidak sekadar menjadi feature executor, tetapi mampu berpikir sebagai problem solver dan business partner. Fulltime Surabaya Rp 8.000.000 - Rp 11.000.000

jobs.title: Product Lead - Flight Product Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.11.04 Job TypeRegular TeamProduct Management Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000437* **About the Role** Traveloka is looking for a Product Manager Lead to drive flight supply operational performance across all markets and lead a team of Product Operations. You will combine product thinking, flight supply expertise and people leadership to improve inventory quality, fare competitiveness, price accuracy and booking reliability. Ideally, you bring product management experience in flight supply or an equivalent domain, alongside a strong understanding of product operations. **Key Responsibilities** * Own operational results across flight markets, translating business objectives into clear plans and measurable outcomes while balancing customer impact, commercial value, technical feasibility and risk. * Demonstrate product thinking to recurring operational challenges, including defining quantified problems, evaluating trade-offs, shaping requirements and measuring outcomes. * Lead investigations and improvements across inventory availability, pricing, supplier integrations, booking and ticket issuance, using data, API logs and transaction evidence to guide decisions. * Align Business, Product, Integration, Supply Platform, Engineering and suppliers on priorities, ownership and delivery commitments, maintaining accountability through to verified outcomes. * Lead and develop five Product Operations ICs through clear expectations, delegation, coaching, performance management, workload planning and cross-training. * Oversee operational incidents, configuration changes and launches, ensuring appropriate approvals, testing, recovery plans and post-change validation. * Drive consistent playbooks, process improvements and validated AI or automation adoption, partnering with the separately led Operational Excellence function and measuring sustained benefits. **Requirements** * Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience across product management, flight supply, airline distribution, travel technology, product operations or related domains. * Product management experience in flight supply or an equivalent domain is strongly preferred, with demonstrated problem framing, prioritization and delivery of measurable outcomes. * Strong expertise in flight distribution and integrations, including GDS, NDC, airline-direct and third-party supply, alongside a practical understanding of product operations. * Proven people leadership, including setting direction, delegating, coaching, managing performance and delivering results through others. * Strong analytical, commercial and stakeholder management skills, including practical SQL proficiency, the ability to interpret API logs and transaction behavior, and experience securing cross-functional commitments.

jobs.title: A&A - Analyst - IT Controls, AI, Data & Data Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml: » * Start apply with LinkedIn * Apply Now * Start * **Please wait...** **A&A - Analyst - IT Controls, AI, Data & Data Analytics** ========================================================== Date: 4 Nov 2026 Service Line / Portfolios: Assurance Location: Jakarta, ID **Title:** Service Line (based in Jakarta) – Associate, Analyst, Consultant **Are you ready to unleash your potential?** At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve. We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices. Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals. We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognised for their contributions. Ready to unleash your potential with us? jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.descriptionHtml: The Sales Development Representative is the starting point of AMODA's outbound engine. You will find and qualify companies that need fast, modular buildings (offices, outlets, clinics, sales galleries, site facilities), book meetings for our Business Development team, and make sure every meeting you hand over is genuinely worth a BD's time. You will work from target lists prepared with Marketing, and your success is measured by meetings that BDs accept and that move forward into design. Responsibilities * Plan and build contact lists in target segments (manufacturing, retail, corporate, healthcare, property) from target lists, LinkedIn, databases, and partner networks. * Run multi-channel outreach (phone, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn) following AMODA's cadence and scripts. * Reach a consistent daily activity level and log every activity in Bigin. * Qualify prospects against AMODA's criteria: real need, project location, timeline within 6 months, reaction to indicative pricing, decision maker access, and minimum deal size. * Book first meetings for the Mid-size BD team and hand over complete lead information in Bigin. * Nurture leads that are not ready yet and re-engage them when timing fits. * Share weekly insights on objections, segment response, and message performance with BD and Marketing. * Help refine target lists, scripts, and qualification criteria based on what converts. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in any field (Business, Marketing, Communication, Architecture or Engineering is a plus). * 1–3 years of experience in outbound sales, telesales, SDR/BDR, or business development, preferably B2B. * Comfortable making many calls and messages per day and handling rejection. * Good written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia; working English. * B2B prospecting in construction, property, building materials, interior, or industrial products. * Experience using a CRM (Bigin, Zoho, HubSpot, Pipedrive) and LinkedIn for prospecting. * Track record of hitting meeting or lead targets. * High energy, fast pace, and persistence in follow-up. * Curious and good at asking questions to uncover real needs. * Disciplined and organized; keeps data clean. * Coachable and open to feedback.

jobs.title: Operations Support Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge. **Job Description** ------------------- **Accountabilities:** **Supply continuity and supplier coordination** * Consolidate center requirements and maintain visibility of approved orders, lead times and replenishment needs with center managers. Identify shortages, unusual consumption and delivery risks early; coordinate supplier follow-up, approved cross-center ordering and escalation so center teams can plan timely action. * Coordinate supplier registration and master-data requests through approved owners. Maintain alignment of approved products, catalogues, pack sizes and order units, and follow through on delivery or quantity discrepancies. Route proposed alternatives to Procurement and Quality for approval before use. **Purchase-to-pay follow-through and spend visibility** * Prepare and progress purchase requisitions, purchase orders and approved blanket-order arrangements with accurate coding, cost-center allocation and approval routing. Confirm receipt evidence with the authorized receiving owner and track open commitments through delivery and transaction closure. * Independently investigate invoice differences in price, quantity, pack size, receipts and coding. Coordinate corrections, credit notes and shared-service tickets with suppliers, Procurement and Finance; track blocked invoices, supplier reminders and payment-status enquiries to resolution and escalate aging items. * Reconcile open orders, outstanding invoices and supporting evidence at period end, providing Finance with reliable inputs for accrual assessment. Compare orders, consumption and spend to highlight unusual patterns and recurring cost or transaction issues for center managers and budget owners. **Operational service coordination** * Maintain a clear operational service-request register and agreed follow-up schedule for centers. Coordinate authorized vendor visits, delivery and service dates with center teams and the relevant Facilities, Engineering, EHS, IT or other technical owner, keeping overdue supplier actions and service interruptions visible. * Collect service-completion documentation from accountable owners and track renewal dates for approved operational services. Raise upcoming decisions and unresolved dependencies early, enabling the responsible owner to assess requirements, accept work and approve any renewal. **Center opening, scale-up and handover** * Support operational setup through a repeatable checklist covering approved supplier registration, order and receipt routing, confirmed cost centers, authorized system-access requests and activation of initial approved supplies and services. Track unresolved supply and payment dependencies with accountable launch and center leaders. * Support focused stabilization after opening and a structured handover to local owners, with clear contacts, open items, follow-up dates and practical operating routines. Capture lessons learned and apply approved improvements across subsequent center openings without independently changing controlled content. **User enablement, process improvement and exception reporting** * Provide first-line guidance on approved purchasing, receipt and related support processes. Maintain approved job aids and reusable trackers, and progress system or shared-service tickets with the responsible team. Coordinate catalogue and master-data corrections to improve transaction quality. * Identify root causes of repeated errors, delays and avoidable rework. Propose practical improvements, agree changes with process owners and help embed consistent local routines while accurately applying approved standards and controls. * Provide a concise weekly or otherwise agreed view of supply risks, open orders, blocked invoices, overdue service actions and recurring bottlenecks. Prioritize follow-through using operational impact and urgency, identify accountable action owners and deadlines within this remit, and provide clear progress and escalation updates. Maintain complete, accurate and securely accessible transaction and service evidence for operational review, period-end reconciliation and audits. Use practical indicators such as overdue actions, exception aging and repeat discrepancies to make support performance and improvement opportunities visible. * Ensure all administrative activities comply with Takeda’s Ethics & Compliance requirements, while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy, and timely delivery. **Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):** * Diploma or equivalent relevant qualification in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance or a related discipline. Demonstrated hands-on experience in purchasing, invoice follow-up or supplier and service coordination, with the ability to resolve transactional issues independently. * Strong attention to detail, structured problem solving and ownership of follow-through. Ability to prioritize competing center needs, work through market-entry ambiguity and communicate constructively across cultures and functions. Experience in regulated, multi-site operations or center setup is preferred. * Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and strong working English. Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment in escalation and a collaborative, service-oriented approach are essential. * Working knowledge of the purchase-to-pay cycle, including requisitions, purchase orders, blanket orders, receipt evidence, invoice matching, credit notes and exception resolution. Ability to investigate order-unit, pack-size, price and quantity differences and provide clear reconciliation evidence. * Practical capability in supplier and operational service administration, order and lead-time tracking, service-request follow-up and renewal-date visibility. Understanding of approval routing, segregation of duties and accurate operational recordkeeping in a controlled environment. * Confident use of Excel and reporting tools to reconcile information, analyze consumption and spend, and maintain actionable trackers. Ability to work with approved purchasing and business systems, communicate clear support tickets and maintain catalogue, master-data and document quality. **Locations** ------------- Jakarta, Indonesia **Worker Type** --------------- Employee **Worker Sub-Type** ------------------- Regular **Time Type** ------------- Full time

jobs.title: Production Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml: Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. We are frontrunners in developing renewable alternatives to fossil-based materials. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. We live by our values – trust and be trusted, achieve together, renew with courage. Together we can renew the everyday, for a future beyond fossils! Learn more about us as a workplace upm.com/careers We are now looking for a **Production Assistant** . This position is located in **Cikarang, Bekasi, Indonesia.** **What you will do** * Assist in managing terminal operation. To be second in charge of Terminal Operation Manager and assist with the assigned project. Manage stock preparation of indirect materials, spare part, tools and equipment for the production lines. Manage preventive maintenance plan of whole terminal * Arrange production planning and overtime management, monitor staff performance and provide guidance, coaching and training onboarding of new employees. Assist in preparing daily production schedules, work plan, and activities report * Help ensure that company policies, procedures, and operational standards are followed. Communicate important information and operational issues to the Terminal Manager. Respond quickly and effectively to operational issues or emergencies. Assist the management team in achieving sales, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets * Coordinate with the relevant departments-Engineering team, BSS, IT, Sales and customer service to ensure production requirements are met. Understand and apply operational knowledge of the daily procedures, safety standards, inventory / stock and company policies * Communicate production updates and instructions to relevant team members. Assist with coordination between departments, suppliers, and service providers. Respond to routine inquiries and escalate issues to the appropriate manager. Attend production meetings and record key information and action items. Help maintain an organized, clean, and safe production work area * Maintain accurate and up-to-date production information, standard operating procedures (SOP’s), follow company policies and workplace safety requirements. Manage PO/PR related documents to ensure sufficient stock of indirect materials and spare parts, including finding supplier, RFQ and 3rd party contractor. Prepare, organize and maintain production documents, forms, reports and records. Completed the others task assigned by Terminal Manager. Prepare daily, weekly, or monthly production reports as required. Track outstanding tasks and follow up with relevant personnel * Assist in checking the availability of materials, tools, and equipment. Coordinate the delivery, collection, and distribution of production supplies. Report damage, missing, or insufficient materials and equipment. Maintain proper housekeeping and organization in the production area Implement the UPM safety rules and standard with regard to the JA terminal operations. Lead environmental training, safety and 5S activities. Support corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as directed **Who you are** * You hold a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering. You have additional training in business, which is an advantage. You may also be considered if you have a different academic background considered supported by type and duration of relevant work experience * You have at least 2-4 years of experience in a similar position, or in a supervisory, team lead, or other relevant role. You have previous experience in production, administration, operations, or coordination; however, it is preferred rather than required. You are fluent in both written and spoken English, with other languages being an advantage * You are proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word and Power Point), and knowledge with SAP, email, data entry and other applications will be an advantage * You have positive attitude and ability to collaborate across the boundaries in a cross functional team. You have strong leadership and communication skills at all levels and good foundation of interpersonal skills * You have strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, organizational and time management skills, team management capabilities and willingness to learn. You are reliable, responsible, and able to work independently and under pressure * You are flexible and willing to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required. You can prioritize your workload and manage multiple tasks. You have safety awareness You are good at documentation and record-keeping. You can work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines **This is what we offer to you** * **A meaningful job:** We have an inspiring purpose “We renew the everyday for a future beyond fossils”. Our work is impactful and transformative. * **A caring community:** Our community is built on great team spirit and shared commitment. We care about each other and the well-being of our colleagues. We support the work-life balance of all our employees. * **Development opportunities:** We offer you great opportunities to learn and grow throughout your career. We are an international, multi-business organization offering plenty of avenues for personal growth. * **Responsible employer:** Sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to ambitious, science-based sustainability targets in all areas, from climate change mitigation to enhancing biodiversity. We foster diversity and inclusivity, offering a work environment in which everyone can be themselves. Learn about our Rewarding and our Ways of working > **Additional information about the position** --------------------------------------------- For support with submitting your application, please contact the HR Service Center at careers@upm.com . #LI-DNP

jobs.title: Identity Management Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** **About Grab and Our Workplace** Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility. **Job Description** **Get to Know the Team** Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to out-serve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences. We are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team The Identity Management team is responsible for managing identities and privileged access across Grab's enterprise infrastructure. The team maintains core identity and access solutions, helping to secure Grab's privileged access landscape. **Get to Know the Role** In this position, you'll be supporting Grab's enterprise infrastructure with an emphasis on Identity and Privileged Access Management. The Identity Management team at Grab is committed to overseeing access to Grab's enterprise applications and safeguarding access to vital systems and sensitive data. Our mission is “Empowering Grabbers with secure, seamless access to systems and data; simplifying productivity and creating time for what matters”. Our responsibilities include ongoing monitoring, auditing, and regular reviews to uphold a robust access control environment. A mindset geared towards optimisation and automation is essential, along with the ability to work independently and foster relationships with stakeholders throughout Grab. If you believe you have what it takes, we'd love to hear from you! **The Critical Tasks You Will Perform** **Privileged Access Management & Engineering** * Implement and operate **CyberArk solutions** including **Privilege Cloud, Secure Web Sessions (SWS), Remote Access, Conjur and Secure Cloud Access.** * Configure safes, platforms, credential rotation, session monitoring and access workflows to enforce **least privilege and secure privileged access**. * Onboard applications, infrastructure and cloud environments into CyberArk, ensuring alignment with PAM standards. **Integration, Automation & Governance** * Develop **automation - scripts or integrations** to improve onboarding, credential management and overall PAM efficiency. * Support **audits and compliance** by providing access evidence, logs and ensuring controls are operating effectively. * Proactively identify gaps in privileged access coverage and drive improvements across the environment. * **Identity Operations** + Manage incidents and service requests related to Identity services, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations. + Configure, support, and maintain the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform, ensuring stability, performance, and security. + Provision and deprovision privileged access in accordance with the principles of least privilege, segregation of identities, and separation of duties. + Drive periodic access reviews for privileged accounts within CyberArk, ensuring ongoing compliance and appropriate access levels. + Develop custom plugins and integrations within CyberArk to extend functionality and enable interoperability with other enterprise systems and platforms. + Support audits and forensic investigations by supplying compliance evidence, access logs, and other relevant data. + Manage and monitor ticket queues, develop and track KPIs/KRIs to provide insights, and identify opportunities for operational improvements. + Develop and maintain documentation, including best practices, technical guides, and standard operating procedures. **Qualifications** **What Essential Skills You Will Need** * **4–6 years of strong hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM/PAM)**, with a primary focus on Privileged Access Management. * **Proven, deep hands-on experience with CyberArk (not just familiarity or exposure)**, including: + Privilege Cloud + Secure Web Sessions (SWS) + Remote Access + Conjur (Secrets Management) + Experience configuring safes, platforms, policies, credential rotation and session monitoring + Use of CyberArk APIs for plugins, automations and integrations. * Demonstrated experience **implementing, onboarding and operating CyberArk across applications, infrastructure and cloud environments**. * Hands-on experience with a leading Identity platform such as **JumpCloud (preferred), Okta, Azure AD or similar**. * Strong understanding of **PAM principles** (least privilege, just-in-time access, credential vaulting, session monitoring, segregation of duties). * Solid foundation in **IAM concepts** including identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, SSO and access governance. * Experience working with **security, risk and compliance teams**, including supporting audits and interactions with auditors. * Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to **automate and troubleshoot using scripting** (Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar). * Experience contributing to **IAM/PAM implementations or transformation initiatives**, from design through execution. * Strong ownership mindset — **proactive, self-driven, and willing to take responsibility end-to-end**. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with **globally distributed, cross-functional teams**, and the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. **Additional Information** **Life at Grab** We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer: * We have your back with **Term Life Insurance** and comprehensive **Medical Insurance.** * With **GrabFlex,** create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations. * Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through **Parental** and **Birthday leave**, and give back to your communities through **Love-all-Serve-all (LASA)** volunteering leave * We have a confidential **Grabber Assistance Programme** to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges. * Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours **What We Stand For At Grab** We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

jobs.title: General Process Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Job Descriptions** * Develop, configure, and optimize industrial processes from inception through startup and certification. * Assess and evaluate production processes by taking accurate measurements and interpreting data. * Design and implement innovative processes, systems, and solutions to enhance production rates and output quality. * Manage the introduction of new products and processes into the production environment for mass production. * Maintain and reduce production costs and time constraints to ensure efficient operations. * Perform risk assessments to identify potential failures in the production process through PFMEA/DFMEA. * Review design for manufacturability (ease of assembly), 2D Review, 3D Review, develop BOM, assembly chronology, and prepare standard work instructions. ### **Requirements** **Educational Qualification:** * Minimum Diploma (D3/D4) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field. **Experience:** * Experience in process simulations and various manufacturing systems and improvements such as Kaizen, lean manufacturing, PFMEA, and PDCA. **Technical Skills:** * Have an understanding of new product development processes. * Have the ability to analyze statistical data. * Have the ability to use CAD/CAM (Experience with Solidworks or Onshape is a plus). * Have knowledge of process-related standards and health-safety regulations. * Have a working knowledge of using process engineering software. **Soft Skills:** * Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills. * Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. * Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams. ### **How to Apply** * Please fill in your personal data via the link below (Duration : ± 30 minutes) Apply Now * After submit the personal data, you will get the PIN number to do the online test (will appear on a pop-up message and sent to your email) * Click the PIN number to start the online test (Duration : ± 30 minutes) *Notes:* *- Pin number is only valid once* *- The online test is related to basic mechanical and logical thinking.* Best of luck! If you have any questions or problems during this stage, please reach us at email **forindojob@formulatrix.com** or Whatsapp 085741651917

jobs.title: PHP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and enhance web-based applications using PHP. * Build application features and modules based on business requirements and defined specifications. * Develop applications using PHP frameworks such as Laravel or CodeIgniter. * Design, manage, and optimize MySQL databases. * Develop and integrate REST APIs with internal systems and third-party services. * Perform debugging, testing, and bug fixing. * Ensure applications function properly, securely, and with optimal performance. * Collaborate with developers, UI/UX designers, QA, and other relevant teams throughout the application development process. **Requirements** Requirements: * Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * Min. 1 year of work experience as a PHP Programmer or Web Developer. * Proficiency in PHP programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. * Experience using the Laravel PHP framework. * Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. * Experience using MySQL databases and understanding of SQL queries. * Understanding of REST API concepts and API integration. * Understanding of the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture. **About PT Metrodata Electronics Tbk** PT. Metrodata Electronics Tbk, known as Metrodata Group, is the leading information communication technology (ICT) companies in Indonesia. On 14 February 1990, Metrodata Group launched its Initial Public Offering on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX – MTDL) to raise funds for investment and working capital as well to allow public participation in its development and growth. With more than 40 years of experience in ICT, Metrodata Group has accompanied its customers as they’ve grown their business. Our professional employees continue to develop new innovations and ready to be challenges with the new era. We offer solutions in 8 areas: Cloud Services, Digital Business Platform, Big Data, Security, Business Application, Hybrid IT infrastructure, Consulting & Advisory Services, and Managed services. PT Metrodata Electronics Tbk has also been certified ISO 9001:2015. As prove, Metrodata Group has received number of awards and recognitions for its accomplishments including Forbes 50 Best of Companies 2020, Investor Award Best Listed Companies 2020: Electronics Sector, Warta Ekonomi Magazine: Living Legend Company - Leading ICT Integrator Company, 2019. We believes that a solid and customer satisfaction oriented team is the key to achieve ultimate success. To fulfill that commitment, we invite you, highly commitment professional to explore and be part of our team.

Demonstrate capabilities with moderate level of oversight and collaboration with more senior level professionals. Scope and size of projects they contribute to are generally smaller or they may own a smaller portion of a larger project. May lead a small to medium size effort or project team. This may include health, life accident and disability insurances, paid time off, financial programs and more. Professionals may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus program. By valuing diverse voices and perspectives, we cultivate an authentically inclusive environment for professionals and are able to provide innovative and effective solutions for clients. **Job Segment:** Mechanical Engineer, Engineer, Electrical, Engineering

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi :** * Mahasiswa aktif atau fresh graduate jurusan Teknik Elektro, Teknik Energi Terbarukan, Teknik Fisika, atau bidang relevan. * Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai sistem kelistrikan AC/DC, elektronika, distribusi daya, dan konversi energi. * Memiliki ketertarikan tinggi terhadap riset dan pengembangan teknologi kelistrikan, khususnya solar panel, renewable energy, dan sistem efisiensi energi. * Memahami konsep dasar sistem panel surya (PLTS), inverter, baterai, dan sistem penyimpanan energi menjadi nilai tambah. * Mampu melakukan riset, pengumpulan data, analisis teknis, serta menyusun rekomendasi berdasarkan hasil penelitian. * Memiliki kemampuan dasar dalam melakukan perhitungan kebutuhan daya, konsumsi energi, dan estimasi efisiensi sistem kelistrikan. * Memiliki pengalaman proyek akademik, penelitian, atau tugas akhir terkait energi terbarukan maupun sistem kelistrikan menjadi nilai tambah * Siap internship selama 6 bulan **Tanggung Jawab :** * Melakukan riset terkait teknologi panel surya dan alternatif sumber energi listrik yang berpotensi diterapkan pada infrastruktur perusahaan. * Menganalisis kebutuhan konsumsi daya dan peluang efisiensi energi pada infrastruktur operasional Jinom. * Melakukan studi kelayakan awal penerapan solar panel, termasuk kebutuhan kapasitas, estimasi investasi, dan potensi penghematan biaya. * Membandingkan berbagai teknologi kelistrikan berdasarkan aspek teknis, efisiensi, keandalan, dan biaya implementasi. * Membantu penyusunan simulasi, desain konsep, atau proof of concept (PoC) sederhana berdasarkan hasil riset. * Mengidentifikasi potensi penerapan teknologi kelistrikan yang dapat mendukung efisiensi dan keberlanjutan operasional perusahaan. * Menyusun laporan riset, dokumentasi teknis, serta mempresentasikan hasil analisis dan rekomendasi kepada tim terkait. jobs.title: Process Electrician Superintendent
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Process Electrician Superintendent role requires an in-depth understanding of project execution strategies, workforce management theories, and Process Electrician principles, with a basic knowledge of related disciplines. The Process Electrician Superintendent must be able to apply industry insights to enhance on-site productivity, provide leadership, and influence processes and policies for effective workforce governance, as well as identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational problems that impact project outcomes. The Process Electrician Superintendent’s decisions are pivotal in ensuring that the team meets its objectives with efficiency and adherence to safety standards. These decisions should be guided by established policies, resource allocations, budget considerations, and the overarching project plan. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Supervise all process electrical activities in the fabrication department, ensuring that installation, maintenance, and repair work is performed in accordance with project specifications and safety standards * Enforce adherence to electrical safety regulations and best practices, conducting regular safety meetings and training to maintain a zero-incident workplace * Collaborate with project managers and other superintendents to coordinate electrical tasks with the overall project schedule, ensuring timely completion and integration with other trades * Oversee the selection, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems, including power distribution, control systems, and instrumentation * Manage a team of process electricians, providing leadership, guidance, and support to achieve high-quality electrical work and adherence to industry standards * Monitor the use of materials and equipment, maintaining inventory control and ensuring the availability of necessary resources for project execution * Perform quality control inspections of electrical work, verifying that installations are up to code and meet operational requirements * Communicate effectively with clients, contractors, and team members to provide updates, resolve issues, and ensure project objectives are met * Own and lead the implementation, enforcement, and verification of compliance with all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure employees understand their responsibility and authority to effectively implement the requirements of all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure the timely completion of all mandatory training by themselves and their teams **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Technical diploma or certification in Electrical Technology, Industrial Electricity, or a related field, with a strong background in process electrical work within a fabrication setting * Proven experience as a process electrician with a history of progression to supervisory roles, demonstrating the ability to manage teams and projects * Knowledge of electrical codes, standards, and practices, with a focus on safety and quality in electrical installations and maintenance * Experience in implementing and maintaining electrical safety protocols, with a commitment to creating a safe working environment * Leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor and motivate electricians to perform at their best * Organizational and planning skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively to meet project deadlines * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders and convey technical information clearly * Flexibility to adapt to different project requirements and work environments, including the availability to work overtime or on shifts as needed #LI-DL1

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. In this role, you will develop visual concepts, create engaging graphics across digital and print media, and ensure our brand identity remains strong and consistent. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and product managers to translate strategic goals into high-impact visual stories. **Key Responsibilities** * **Visual Asset Creation:** Design compelling graphics for digital channels (social media, website banners, email templates, digital ads) and print materials (brochures, flyers, packaging, event collateral). * **Brand Management:** Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, ensuring consistent visual identity across all marketing touchpoints. * **Collaboration & Concepting:** Brainstorm visual concepts with cross-functional teams and translate creative briefs into clear design solutions. * **Production & Pre-Press:** Prepare final production-ready files for web (optimized formats) and print (color proofing, bleed, typography adjustments). * **Project Management:** Prioritize multiple design requests, meet tight deadlines, and incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently. **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience with a strong portfolio). * **Portfolio:** A diverse portfolio showcasing expertise in typography, layout, color theory, and visual story-telling across digital and print formats. * **Technical Proficiency:**⚬ Advanced skills in **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).⚬ Hands-on experience with modern design/prototyping tools like **Figma** or **Sketch**. * **Design Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of composition, grid systems, image editing, and digital media formats. * **Soft Skills:** Strong communication skills, openness to constructive feedback, and the ability to manage time independently in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Basic knowledge of motion graphics/video editing (**Adobe After Effects** or **Premiere Pro**). * Experience with HTML/CSS or email marketing builders (e.g., Mailchimp, Figma-to-code plugins). * Familiarity with UI/UX principles and digital accessibility (WCAG) standards. Work Location: In person

Your expertise in the telecommunications industry will be essential in delivering solutions that meet both business and user goals. **Key Responsibilities:** * Conduct user research and usability testing to gather insights and understand user needs. * Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile applications. * Develop user personas and customer journey maps to inform design decisions. * Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure design feasibility and alignment with business objectives. * Design and maintain a consistent visual language and design system across all digital touchpoints. * Analyze user feedback and metrics to iterate on designs and improve user experience. * Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in UX/UI and CX design. **Qualifications:** * **Thai native only** * Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 3-10 years of experience in UI/UX and CX design, Human-Computer Interaction, preferably in the telecommunications industry. * Strong portfolio showcasing design projects and process, with a focus on user-centered design. * Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar. * Experience with user research methodologies and usability testing. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously. **If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.** **The exceptional EY experience. jobs.title: UI-UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk or Adira Finance was established in 1990 and started its operation in 1991. Since the beginning, Adira Finance committed to be the best and foremost finance company in Indonesia. Adira Finance presents to serve various financing as of vehicles, both new or used ones. Recognize the potential, Adira Finance began to conduct initial public offering for its shares in 2004 and Bank Danamon became the majority shareholder with 75% ownership. Through some corporate actions, currently Bank Danamon owns 92.07% of Adira Finance’s shares. Adira Finance is becoming part of Temasek Holding, an investment company owned by the Government of Singapore. In 2012, Adira Finance has augmented its business activities with sharia financing. In order to provide maximum financing service, the Company begin to provide durables financing for its customers. Until 2015, Adira Finance operated 558 business networks throughout Indonesia and supported by more than 21 thousand employees, to serve 3 million customers with more than Rp40 trillion of managed receivables. Adira Finance continuously contributes to the nation and the country of Indonesia. Through its brand identity and commitment, namely “Sahabat Setia Selamanya”, Adira Finance committed to impose its mission which ends with the increment of the welfare of the Indonesian society. It is performed through the providing of various products and services according to the customers’ life cycle as well as providing beneficial experiences to the customers. **Job Description** Are you a highly skilled UI/UX Designer? Do you thrive in a collaborative team environment where you can exchange creative ideas and concepts? Your role at Adira Finance will be strategic, conceptual, and executional—leveraging design as a way of articulating possibilities, solutions and vision We are looking for a highly creative individual to join our team as a Creative Designer! As a UI/UX Designer, your responsibilities are: * Provide real innovative on-line experience and design prototypes * Illustrate design ideas using storyboards, process flows and sitemaps * Design graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs and widgets * Collaborate with product/project manager and engineers to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals and experience * Prepare and present rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders * Incorporate design into existing/developed applications * Establish and promote design guidelines, best practices and standards * Work in an Agile team where there is close collaboration with the front-end and back-end developers and in an iterative manner. * Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g. responsiveness) * Conduct layout adjustments based on user feedback **Qualifications** **Who is right for the job?** * Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, Art/Design/Creative Multimedia, Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent. * At least 1 year(s) of working experience in the related field is **required** for this position. * Exceptional design skills, and attention to detail * Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Wireframe.cc and InVision) Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop * Keep up-to-date with current design trends * Good knowledge of the UI/ UX methodology * Passion for creating experiences in online environments * Understanding of Agile software development * Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills **Additional Information** Note : To be considered, all applicants must submit a link to a portfolio site to https://bit.ly/2G0w9Fi

jobs.title: UI/UX Design (Full-Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description:** * Merancang user interface (UI) dan user experience (UX) untuk website, aplikasi, dan platform digital perusahaan. * Melakukan riset pengguna untuk memahami kebutuhan, perilaku, dan permasalahan pengguna. * Membuat user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype sebagai acuan pengembangan produk digital. * Mengembangkan desain yang intuitif, menarik, responsif, dan mudah digunakan. * Melakukan usability testing serta mengevaluasi desain berdasarkan feedback pengguna. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product Manager, Developer, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan desain dapat diimplementasikan sesuai kebutuhan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara design system serta menjaga konsistensi visual pada produk digital. * Melakukan evaluasi dan perbaikan desain secara berkala berdasarkan hasil pengujian dan kebutuhan bisnis. * Memastikan desain sesuai dengan prinsip usability, accessibility, dan responsive design. * Mengikuti perkembangan tren desain UI/UX serta menerapkan praktik terbaik dalam pengembangan produk digital. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Desain Komunikasi Visual, Desain Grafis, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai UI/UX Designer menjadi nilai tambah. * Menguasai Figma atau tools desain sejenis. * Memahami prinsip UI/UX design, user-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, dan usability testing. * Memiliki kemampuan menyusun user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype interaktif. * Memahami responsive design serta prinsip dasar accessibility. * Memiliki portofolio desain UI/UX yang menunjukkan proses dan hasil perancangan. * Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, kreatif, dan berorientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens * At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail * Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built * Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers * Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer. * Balances outcomes for both users and the business #### **Preferred (Nice to have)** * Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools * Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow * A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software * Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus ‍ If you are interested please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange. Only successful applicants will be contacted.
