jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Brand Designer** ------------------ Jakarta, Indonesia Full-TimeDesign #### **Role Description** As a Brand Designer, you will be involved in creating brand identities, visual systems, packaging, communication materials, websites and digital touchpoints for our clients’ brands. You will work closely with designers, brand strategists, developers and other team members to bring ideas from concept to completion. This role is suited for someone who is strong in visual design, but also interested in strategy, user needs, business context and how brands come to life across different touchpoints. You will be expected to develop creative concepts, design brand identities, prepare presentation decks, create marketing and communication materials, support packaging and digital design, and ensure brand consistency across applications. We are looking for someone who is independent, responsive, communicative, adaptable and driven. The ideal candidate is not only strong in execution, but also confident in sharing ideas, asking thoughtful questions, proposing better ways forward and working closely with the team to push creative boundaries. We are also looking for someone who is AI native, curious about new tools and able to use AI to support research, ideation, visual exploration, content development and workflow efficiency without losing strong design judgment. #### **Responsibilities** * Create brand identity systems, visual concepts, graphic design, packaging design, website design and digital design assets for clients across different industries * Develop creative concepts based on strategy, user needs and business objectives * Translate brand strategy into meaningful and distinctive visual expressions * Design brand applications across print, digital, packaging, social media, websites and other touchpoints * Prepare presentation decks and communicate design ideas clearly to internal teams and clients * Support user research, competitor research, visual research and design exploration * Use Figma, Adobe Creative Suite and relevant design tools to create high-quality design work * Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, visual exploration and workflow efficiency * Work with developers to ensure the website and digital design intent are translated clearly into execution * Manage design tasks independently and ensure timelines are met * Communicate progress, challenges and ideas clearly without waiting to be asked * Be responsive and proactive in team discussions, client communication and project coordination * Maintain brand consistency across different brand touchpoints * Push creative boundaries while ensuring the work remains strategic, relevant and practical #### **What We're Looking For** We are looking for a designer who not only makes things look good, but also thinks, questions, explores and proposes better ways forward. You should be comfortable working in a dynamic consultancy environment where every project is different. You should be curious about business, brands, users, technology, culture, and the role design plays in shaping perception and growth. You should also be open to learning and using new tools, especially AI tools, to make your creative process sharper, faster and more effective. We value designers who communicate openly and proactively. This means you should be comfortable updating the team, sharing your point of view, asking the right questions, raising challenges early and contributing actively from brief to final delivery. Most importantly, you should care about creating design that is meaningful, strategic and useful. **Requirements** * Strong portfolio in brand identity, graphic design, visual communication or related work * Good sense of typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and Figma * Ability to think conceptually and translate ideas into clear visual directions * Interest in branding, business, culture, users and design strategy * Good communication skills and willingness to present ideas * Ability to work independently and collaboratively * Experience in packaging, UI/UX, motion, social media content or AI-assisted design tools will be an advantage **How to Apply** Please submit your CV and portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on-site interview.

jobs.title: Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Welcome to IHG Hotels & Resorts** =================================== We are one of the world’s leading hospitality organisations, with a global portfolio of over 6,600 hotels and more than 375,000 colleagues. Whether your passion lies in driving commercial success, building powerful brands, creating meaningful customer connections, or delivering exceptional guest experiences, there is **Room for You at IHG**. We are looking for a **Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing** to join our leadership team at Hotel Indigo Bintan and Holiday Inn Resort Bintan. As Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing, you will provide strategic leadership and direction for the overall commercial performance of both properties. You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You will lead the Sales & Marketing team, oversee key account management, develop effective marketing initiatives, and work closely with Revenue Management and Operations teams to ensure alignment with the overall business strategy. **Your Day-to-Day** * Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to achieve revenue targets, maximise market share, and strengthen the positioning of both properties. * Lead, coach, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to deliver strong commercial results and achieve individual and departmental objectives. * Drive business development across key market segments, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and other revenue-generating opportunities. * Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, media, and business partners. * Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing, digital marketing, public relations, and promotional campaigns to enhance brand awareness and generate business. * Monitor market intelligence, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify new opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. * Work closely with Revenue Management to develop pricing strategies, optimise business mix, and maximise overall revenue performance. * Oversee sales forecasts, budgets, marketing expenditures, and departmental performance, ensuring effective resource allocation and return on investment. * Drive cross-property commercial initiatives and ensure consistency in sales and marketing strategies while respecting each brand's positioning and identity. * Collaborate with General Managers, Revenue Management, and Operations teams to align commercial strategies with overall business priorities. * Monitor commercial performance through regular reviews, reporting, and strategic action plans to ensure business objectives are achieved. * Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with IHG brand standards, corporate guidelines, and relevant policies. **What We Need From You** * Proven experience in hotel sales and marketing, preferably in a Director of Sales & Marketing or senior commercial leadership position. * Strong understanding of the hospitality industry, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and digital marketing segments. * Demonstrated success in developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver revenue growth, market share expansion, and strong business performance. * Proven leadership capabilities with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop high-performing teams. * Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, and experience managing departmental budgets, forecasts, and business performance. * Excellent strategic planning, negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. * Strong knowledge of digital marketing, brand positioning, public relations, and market development strategies. * Ability to analyse market trends, interpret business data, and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies. * Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with ownership, corporate teams, General Managers, and business partners. * A strategic thinker with a proactive, innovative, and results-driven mindset. * Excellent command of English; additional language skills would be an advantage. **If you are a commercially driven leader with a passion for hospitality, strategic marketing, and developing high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you.** Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 150 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Mengembangkan dan menjalankan strategi brand marketing secara menyeluruh yang selaras dengan tujuan bisnis, positioning brand, dan target pertumbuhan revenue. * Memimpin pengembangan brand, positioning, dan identitas brand untuk meningkatkan brand awareness, market presence, dan loyalitas pelanggan. * Mengawasi pelaksanaan integrated marketing campaign melalui kanal digital, social media, offline, dan experiential marketing untuk memaksimalkan exposure dan engagement brand. * Mengidentifikasi tren pasar, consumer insight, dan aktivitas kompetitor untuk mengembangkan strategi marketing yang relevan serta peluang bisnis. * Mengarahkan inisiatif marketing yang berkontribusi terhadap pertumbuhan revenue, customer acquisition, customer retention, dan performa bisnis secara keseluruhan. * Memimpin pengembangan komunikasi brand, aktivitas promosi, dan creative concept melalui kolaborasi dengan tim internal maupun external partner. * Mengelola marketing budget, alokasi sumber daya, dan performa campaign untuk memastikan efisiensi biaya serta optimalisasi return on investment. * Berkolaborasi dengan Brand Owner, Operations, Creative, Marcomm, dan stakeholder terkait untuk memastikan keselarasan antara strategi marketing dan prioritas bisnis. * Memimpin, mengembangkan, dan mengelola tim brand marketing untuk memastikan efektivitas pelaksanaan, pencapaian target, dan continuous improvement. * Memantau performa marketing melalui key metrics, analytics, dan reporting, serta memberikan rekomendasi strategis untuk meningkatkan performa brand dan hasil bisnis. **Persyaratan** --------------- * Pendidikan minimal S1 Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5–7 tahun di bidang Brand Marketing, Marketing Strategy, atau posisi terkait, dengan minimal 2–3 tahun pengalaman di posisi managerial atau leadership. * Memiliki pengalaman di industri Lifestyle, F&B, Nightlife, Hospitality, atau Entertainment. * Memahami brand strategy, consumer behavior, integrated marketing campaign, digital marketing, dan market positioning. * Memiliki kemampuan dalam mengembangkan strategi marketing yang mampu meningkatkan brand awareness, customer engagement, dan revenue growth. * Memiliki kemampuan leadership, strategic thinking, analytical thinking, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang kuat. **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen BRAND STRATEGIC DEPARTMENT I Outlet Sentral QBIG 2 Kebutuhan 1 Orang · Wanita

jobs.title: ASEA E-Commerce Head
jobs.descriptionHtml: * **Position: ASEA E-Commerce Head** * **Reporting to: General Manager Opella ASEA - CHC AMEA Region** * **Primary Location: Indonesia** * **Alternate locations: Singapore or Philippines** **Locations: Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore. The appointment is intended to be locally based rather than an international relocation.** *Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.* *Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.* *At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.* *Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.* *Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at* *www.opella.com.* **Role Purpose** The ASEA E-Commerce Head will lead Opella’s e-commerce strategy and business across SEA, accelerating sustainable and profitable growth across marketplaces, e-retailers, social commerce, D2C and omnichannel channels. This role will be operated as a business leader and mini-GM for e-commerce business, bringing together strategy, commercial execution, platform and customer partnerships, P&L thinking, digital capability and team leadership. The role will work closely with Country GMs, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Media and cross-functional teams to embed e-commerce into Opella’s overall growth strategy. **Key Responsibilities** **1. E-Commerce Strategy & Business Growth** * Define and lead the ASEA e-commerce strategy, translating regional priorities into differentiated market plans. * Own the e-commerce growth agenda across key ASEA markets. * Identify new growth opportunities across marketplaces, e-retail, quick commerce, social commerce and D2C. * Build clear Scale / Optimize / Stop choices across platforms, brands and markets. * Ensure e-commerce is fully integrated into country commercial and brand strategies. **2. Commercial & P&L Leadership** * Drive sustainable Net Sales, GMV, market share, margin and profitability across e-commerce. * Lead channel economics includes pricing, promotion, investment, assortment and trade spend. * Establish rigorous commercial performance management across markets and platforms. * Balance top-line acceleration with sustainable profitability and investment effectiveness. **3. Marketplace & Customer Leadership** * Develop strategic partnerships with key e-commerce platforms, e-retailers, customers and distributors. * Lead senior engagement and Joint Business Planning with platforms and e-retail partners. * Strengthening Opella’s capabilities across Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and other priority platforms. * Develop platform-specific strategies covering assortment, pricing, promotions, media, content and conversion. **4. Omnichannel & Consumer Experience** * Connect e-commerce with broader pharmacy, modern trade and omnichannel strategies. * Build seamless consumer journeys from awareness and consideration through conversion and repeat purchase. * Partner with Brand and Media teams to connect retail media, performance marketing and commerce. * Drive excellence in digital shelf, content, search, ratings and reviews, and conversion. **5. Data, Insights & Performance** * Build a strong performance culture using consumer, customer and platform data. * Establish common ASEA KPIs and dashboards covering Net Sales, GMV, market share, traffic, conversion, ROAS, basket size, repeat purchase and profitability. * Translate data into clear commercial actions and resource allocation decisions. * Strengthening Opella’s test & learn capability across markets. **6. Social Commerce & Emerging Channels** * Shape the ASEA social commerce strategy, including TikTok Shop, livestream, creators and affiliates. * Identify emerging consumer and commerce trends and translate them into scalable opportunities. * Accelerate successful market pilots across ASEA. **7. Leadership & Capability Building** * Lead, coach and develop e-commerce teams across ASEA. * Build e-commerce capabilities across Commercial, Brand and local market teams. * Create common ways of working, governance and best-practice sharing across markets. * Attract and develop high-performing digital commerce talent. * Foster an entrepreneurial culture with strong accountability for outcomes. **Experience & Knowledge** **Essential** * Proven experience in e-commerce, digital commerce, commercial or omnichannel leadership, ideally within FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Beauty, Personal Care or another consumer-led business. * Experience leading a sizeable B2C e-commerce business. * Strong commercial and P&L orientation with demonstrated accountability for growth and profitability. * Deep understanding of marketplace and e-retail business models. * Experience working with platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and/or other major e-commerce ecosystems. * Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, digital shelf, retail media and conversion. * Proven ability to operate across functions and influence senior stakeholders. * Strong people leadership and capability-building experience. **Preferred** * Regional or multi-country Southeast Asia experience. * Experience across both developed and high-growth e-commerce markets. * Consumer healthcare, FMCG or similarly regulated consumer-category experience. * Experience building or transforming an e-commerce organization rather than only managing an established channel. * Exposure to D2C, social commerce, CRM and consumer data strategies. **Leadership Profile** * **Commercial & Finance acumen:** Treats e-commerce as a business, not simply a digital channel. * **Entrepreneurial:** Comfortable building and scaling new growth models. * **Outcome-obsessed:** Converts strategy into measurable business results. * **Consumer-led:** Understands how consumers discover, evaluate and purchase healthcare products online. * **Data-driven:** Uses insights to challenge assumptions and make faster decisions. * **Enterprise-minded:** Balances market priorities with the wider ASEA and Opella agenda. * **Influential:** Aligns senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. * **Talent-focused:** Builds strong teams and develops e-commerce capability across the organization. ***Why us?*** At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. **We Are Challengers.** We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: **All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. **Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. **Outcome-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. **Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be. Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www.opella.com/en/careers

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production. **Role Summary:** As a Marketing Specialist in ID, you'll drive user adoption of Search and AI features by bridging global innovation and local needs. Combining analytics and storytelling, you'll own campaigns, research user behaviour, and collaborate cross-functionally to optimise engagement in a fast-paced environment. Role: * Develop an insight-led Search marketing plan for the Indonesian market, identifying and prioritising key growth opportunities and feature rollouts for Search, Assistant, and AI-enabled search experiences. * Lead the launch and execution of targeted Search feature campaigns from inception to completion, ensuring all initiatives drive core user adoption and engagement metrics. * Conduct deep research into Search user behaviour, query intent trends, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic product and marketing decisions. * Apply advanced Search analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation (A/B testing) to evaluate search feature performance, user retention, and campaign impact. * Use SQL to analyse large search datasets and user interaction patterns, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for product and marketing partners. * Collaborate closely with product, comms, regional, and in-country teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment across all initiatives. * Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities by developing creative and non-traditional solutions for complex, undefined problems. You: * BA/BS degree or equivalent experience * 3+ years of experience in marketing, consulting, or communications, with a proven track record of exceptional performance and high productivity. * Deep expertise in Search products, digital marketing, and performance marketing for high-growth tech products. * Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, combined with solid project management skills and the ability to lead projects independently. * Proven track record in Search analytics, statistical analysis, user funnel analysis, and controlled experimentation (A/B testing). * Proficiency in SQL to query large search interaction datasets and uncover key insights into Search user behavior. * Exceptional adaptability, strong teamwork skills, dedication, and a positive attitude. * Able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, technology work environment and navigate ambiguity in a complex matrix organisation. * Exceptional verbal and written English, and fluent in Bahasa Indonesia, with strong communication and presentation skills Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager| 100% Remote EU
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*. If you love: * mixing strategy with execution * testing ideas * improving funnels * and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** ------------------------ ### **Strategy & Growth Stuff** * Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). * Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. * Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. * Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. * Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement. ### **Creative & Content Magic** * Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. * Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts. * Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. ### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization** * QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. * Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. * Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. ### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)** * Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. * Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. * Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. ### **Customer Research & Insights** * Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. * Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. * Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. ### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution** * Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ You’re probably someone who: * Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. * Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. * Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. * Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. * Knows CRO and website optimization. * Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” * Is organized and good at managing projects. * Has worked with designers and developers before. * Can manage your own time and work remotely. * Cares about customers and research. * Gets excited about e-commerce growth. **BONUS POINTS IF YOU:** ------------------------ * Have used marketing automation tools. * Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools. * Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop. **WHY FOXELLI?** ---------------- We’re not into boring corporate marketing. We like: * smart ideas * quirky personality * strong execution * and people who take ownership You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work. **THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** --------------------------- Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together. **FIXED SERVICE FEE** **€2,000 - €2,800** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience. Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement. **PERKS & BENEFITS** * Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness. * Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. * A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. * Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. * A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. * Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. **ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS** This role is 100% remote. * Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. * For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*. If you love: * mixing strategy with execution * testing ideas * improving funnels * and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** ------------------------ ### **Strategy & Growth Stuff** * Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). * Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. * Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. * Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. * Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement. ### **Creative & Content Magic** * Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. * Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts. * Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. ### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization** * QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. * Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. * Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. ### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)** * Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. * Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. * Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. ### **Customer Research & Insights** * Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. * Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. * Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. ### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution** * Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ You’re probably someone who: * Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. * Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. * Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. * Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. * Knows CRO and website optimization. * Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” * Is organized and good at managing projects. * Has worked with designers and developers before. * Can manage your own time and work remotely. * Cares about customers and research. * Gets excited about e-commerce growth. **BONUS POINTS IF YOU:** ------------------------ * Have used marketing automation tools. * Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools. * Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop. **WHY FOXELLI?** ---------------- We’re not into boring corporate marketing. We like: * smart ideas * quirky personality * strong execution * and people who take ownership You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work. **THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** --------------------------- Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together. **FIXED SERVICE FEE** **€2,000 - €2,800** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience. Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement. **PERKS & BENEFITS** * Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness. * Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. * A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. * Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. * A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. * Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. **ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS** This role is 100% remote. * Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. * For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Samara Group Samara Group is a luxury yachting company offering private yacht charters, luxury liveaboard experiences, and curated voyages across the Indonesian archipelago. Our portfolio includes Otium Yacht, Mischief Voyage, Samara Liveaboard, and Siloina Surf Charter, each offering distinctive experiences in some of Indonesia's most extraordinary destinations. We are looking for a **Senior Performance Marketing Specialist** to join our marketing team and help strengthen our digital advertising performance. About the Role We are seeking a proactive, analytical, and hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Specialist to manage and optimise our paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads. The ideal candidate has solid experience in digital advertising, understands campaign performance and conversion tracking, and can translate data into practical recommendations. You will work closely with the Marketing Director, Creative, Sales, and Web Development teams to improve campaign effectiveness, generate qualified enquiries, and support our commercial objectives. We value initiative, problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to continuously learn and improve. Key ResponsibilitiesPaid Advertising Management * Plan, execute, monitor, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads. * Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, placements, and bidding strategies. * Conduct A/B testing of advertising creatives, audiences, and campaign approaches. * Monitor campaign performance regularly and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. * Recommend adjustments to improve campaign efficiency and results. Campaign Performance & Lead Generation * Develop and optimise campaigns focused on generating relevant, high-quality enquiries. * Monitor key performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates, and cost per qualified lead. * Analyse campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve lead quality and conversion. * Collaborate with Sales to understand lead quality, customer enquiries, and booking outcomes. * Recommend improvements to audience targeting, advertising creatives, and landing-page conversion performance. Tracking & Analytics * Monitor and maintain conversion tracking across Meta Ads and Google Ads. * Work with Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager (GTM). * Identify potential tracking issues and coordinate with the Web Development team to resolve them. * Ensure campaign tracking and conversion data are accurate and reliable. * Support improvements to CRM attribution and lead tracking. Reporting & Analysis * Prepare concise weekly performance updates and monthly campaign reports. * Analyse advertising performance, campaign spend, lead generation, and conversion results. * Provide clear insights and actionable recommendations based on campaign data. * Track campaign performance against agreed objectives and budgets. * Communicate performance issues and opportunities proactively. Team Collaboration * Work closely with the Marketing Director to align advertising activities with marketing objectives. * Collaborate with the Creative team on advertising materials and content requirements. * Coordinate with Sales to evaluate lead quality and identify opportunities for improvement. * Work with the Web Development team to improve tracking and landing-page performance. * Maintain clear and timely communication on campaign progress, challenges, and recommendations. Requirements & Qualifications * Minimum **3 years of experience** in performance marketing, digital advertising, or a related role. * Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. * Good understanding of audience targeting, campaign optimisation, and lead-generation strategies. * Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Meta Pixel. * Ability to analyse campaign performance and translate data into actionable recommendations. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Proactive, organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. * Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams. * Good command of written and spoken English. Nice to Have * Experience with Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and advanced conversion tracking. * Familiarity with CRM systems and lead attribution. * Experience managing advertising campaigns targeting international markets. * Experience in luxury hospitality, travel, tourism, or other high-value services. * Experience with landing-page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO). What We Offer * Competitive salary based on experience. * The opportunity to work with a portfolio of luxury yachting and travel brands. * Hands-on ownership of paid advertising campaigns and performance optimisation. * A collaborative working environment with direct access to the Marketing Director and supporting teams. * Opportunities to develop technical skills, explore new strategies, and grow professionally. * A dynamic working environment in Bali. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to submit: * An updated CV highlighting relevant experience. * A portfolio or examples of previous Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns, if available. * A brief overview of campaign results or achievements they are proud of. **Join Samara Group and help us create meaningful connections between our brands and travellers around the world.** Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. Through a deep understanding of the country’s customer and channel landscapes, the Group Account Manager will lead a team of Account Managers to collaborate with our partner to develop strategic opportunities resulting in distinctive customer experiences driven growth. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. jobs.title: QA Project and Data Management (SPX)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Operations LevelEntry Level LocationBangkok The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud. Job Description: The Associate will be responsible for driving key QA projects and managing data workflows to improve compliance, efficiency, and audit accuracy across SPX operations. This role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, and data analysis to ensure smooth execution of QA initiatives and to provide actionable insights to leadership. * Lead and support different projects. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders (Ops, BI, Product, Costing, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth execution of the initiatives * Conduct deep-dive data analysis to identify non-compliance trends, operational inefficiencies, and potential fraud cases * Provide data-backed recommendations to improve frameworks, SOPs, and training * Prepare regular reports and insights for management on the performance metrics, compliance trends, and initiative progress * Support audit design and automation efforts to reduce manual work and increase audit accuracy * Conduct site visits to validate on ground practices and identify gaps * Act as a subject matter expert for the team’s data and processes, supporting continuous improvement Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or related fields * Minimum 2–4 years of experience in operations, data analysis, or project management * Strong skills in GSheet/Excel and SQL * Experience in data cleaning, root cause analysis, and translating raw data into actionable insights * Strong project management skills: able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with tight timelines * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both in Thai and English * Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently * Willingness to conduct occasional on-site visits to hubs or warehouses

jobs.title: Project Engineer (Mechanical, Packages & Piping)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** --------------- As a **Project Engineer (Mechanical, Packages & Piping)**, you will contribute to the coordination and delivery of mechanical, package and piping engineering activities within project teams. **Your main responsibilities will be:** * Lead the preparation and review of Material Requisitions / Technical Requirement for purchase requisition. * Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE) * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (process, piping, instrument, automation, electrical, procurement, QA/QC) and vendors. * Follow company procedures as defined in the QA/QC Manual * Support fabrication, inspection, and testing activities (FAT, SAT, inspections) * Provide technical support during construction, installation, and commissioning phases * Prepare and/or coordinate any work procedures that are deemed necessary for manufacturing, handling, assembling, or lifting of the equipment according to client requirement. * Review and resolve technical queries (TQs), NCRs, and deviations at any stage of the project. * Ensure proper documentation and data management throughout the project lifecycle, including installation, commissioning, start-up, operation and maintenance documentation. * Prepare notice at change (NOC) to fabricator via Engineering Manager. * Execute any work related to skills and experience for the Project. **Requirement:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering * Minimum 5 years of experience in oil & gas, petrochemical, or EPC projects * Fluent in English * Experience in vendor management and technical bid evaluations * Familiar with inspection and testing requirements * Experience working in project environments (FEED, EPC, EPCIC) * Good coordination and communication skills

jobs.title: Advanced Project Manager for Installation
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description Summary** =========================== The Advanced Project Manager Installation (PMI) is part of Healthcare Project Management (HPM), responsible for managing wing to wing projects of GE Healthcare (GEHC) business, owns the project management and implementation process for GEHC Diagnostic Imaging, including sales order review, customer meeting, project planning, design/layout, contractor interface, submission of documentation, issue resolution, GE resources coordination which includes product shipping logistics, installation and training. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform & Azure Specialists — Remote Contract Opportunities** **Remote | Contract / Project-Based | International Client Projects** Vurke is expanding its global technology-delivery network and is inviting experienced Microsoft professionals to join our talent community for **current and upcoming remote implementation projects** with Microsoft partners, systems integrators, consulting firms and enterprise clients. We are looking for professionals who have **hands-on implementation experience** across Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform, Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, integration, security, governance, adoption and enterprise automation. This is not one single role. We are currently building delivery capacity across the following specialist areas: 1. **QA / Business Analyst — Microsoft AI & Power Platform** 2. **Microsoft Integration Developer** 3. **Microsoft AI Solution Architect** 4. **Power Platform Architect** 5. **AI / Agent Engineer — Microsoft Ecosystem** 6. **Azure OpenAI Engineer** 7. **Azure AI Engineer** 8. **Copilot Studio Developer** 9. **Power Automate Developer** 10. **Power Platform Developer** 11. **Microsoft AI & Power Platform Business Analyst** **What kind of opportunities are available?** Vurke specialists may work: * As part of a **Vurke delivery team** * As an extension of a **Microsoft partner or systems integrator** * Directly within an enterprise client project under an agreed delivery model * On short-term or longer-term **remote contract assignments** * On international engagements supporting clients in **North America, the United Kingdom and Europe** Vurke is building a technically assessed global talent network focused on real implementation and delivery work—not simply traditional recruitment. **Who should apply?** We want to hear from experienced professionals who can demonstrate: * Real production implementation experience * Strong Microsoft technical or functional expertise * Experience working with enterprise customers or delivery teams * Strong written and spoken English * Ability to work independently in distributed teams * Ability to clearly explain the projects you personally delivered * Availability for remote contract work * Where required, partial overlap with **US, UK or European business hours** Microsoft certifications are valuable, but **practical implementation experience matters more than certification alone**. **How the Vurke process works** Rather than applying separately to multiple job advertisements, you can join Vurke once and create your professional profile. **Step 1 — Create your Vurke profile** Register on the Vurke talent portal. **Step 2 — Upload your CV** Provide a current CV that clearly shows your Microsoft technologies, projects, responsibilities and delivery experience. **Step 3 — Select the role or roles that best match your skills** Choose the opportunities most relevant to your background. **Step 4 — Profile review and matching** Vurke reviews your experience and may use technology-assisted matching to identify suitable roles and projects. **Step 5 — Technical assessment and interview** Shortlisted professionals may be invited to a technical assessment and/or client interview. **Step 6 — Project opportunities** Successful specialists become part of the Vurke talent network and may be considered for suitable current and future international client assignments. Joining the Vurke talent network does not guarantee an immediate project assignment. Opportunities depend on live client requirements, technical fit, availability, time-zone compatibility and commercial agreement. **Why join the Vurke Talent Network?** * **Remote international contract opportunities** * Exposure to projects across **Microsoft AI, Copilot, Azure and Power Platform** * Opportunities with Microsoft partners, technology consultancies and enterprise customers * Project-based work without being limited to one geography * One professional profile that can be considered for multiple relevant opportunities * Technical assessment designed to identify strong delivery professionals * Future matching against new Vurke client requirements * Opportunity to build experience across international technology projects **Apply now** If your background fits **any of the roles above**, create your Vurke profile, upload your CV and select the opportunity most relevant to you: **Apply here:** **https://app.vurke.io/jobs** **Create your Vurke profile once. Be considered for multiple global technology projects.** Work Location: Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We are here to help enterprise businesses transform the way people work— while growing top-line revenue for Apple. To realize this goal, we gain deep understandings of the businesses we manage—at all levels from tactical to strategic. We create a vision that can inspire customers to transform using Apple products. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to create plans for solutions and new use cases, and then we help drive execution of the solution. Description - Advise on business, digital and workplace transformation solutions with strategic large customers together with our partners. - Develop account plans aligned with Enterprises’ and Government strategies, assess their progress and guide them on the journey of transformation, while growing and expanding adoption of the Apple platform and ecosystem. - Responsible for the creation, development and indirect orchestration of key industry sales plays within our customers. - Effectively execute joint account plans by cross-functionally partnering and Strategic partners, driving refresh, expansion and net new platform opportunities. - Identify and create new opportunities driving sales actions on refresh and net new platform opportunities. - Look to create lighthouse references which we can replicate and scale, leveraging success stories that can be told across industry. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. * 10 years of proven sales experience in Indonesia, preferably in capacity with background from IT Software/Services/Hardware * You have consultative selling experience in business transformation solutions for large enterprises. In your experience, you’ve balanced delivering on short-term goals, while creating sustainable value for customers, and demand for the future. Or you bring proven experience as an Account Executive for large Enterprises. * Demonstrated superior communication, relationship building, influencing in both English and Bahasa Indonesia Preferred Qualifications * Master’s degree or equivalent experience * You’re an expert at presenting and handling pressure. You simplify complex information and engage audiences. You empower others to learn and share your passion for the Apple story. When challenged, you share your deep knowledge of hardware, software, and services integration. * Apple prioritizes integrity, honesty, and accountability in all its products and business practices. You’re a trusted advisor who upholds Apple’s values and ensures its best interests are served. * You deeply understand customer needs, challenges, and concerns, enabling you to exceed customer expectations. You connect and influence the right people, both inside and outside Apple, to address unique customer and partner needs. As a go-to person with leadership, you’re comfortable in tough situations, settling disputes, negotiating, and making difficult decisions. You view conflicts as opportunities for growth. * Experience in engaging with Government developing shared vision of use of technology as well as support procurement processes. * Communication is crucial to Apple’s success. You actively engage with customers and peers, exploring endless possibilities. You recognize perspectives, patiently listen to details, and commit to what’s right to drive innovation. * You know yourself and others, and you’re open to feedback. You relate well to all people. When faced with challenges, you know who to connect with and when. People know you as a true collaborator who knows how to win. At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.title: Sales - Technology Strategist, Strategic Accounts, Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it. At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey. The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap. The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core. Description Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation. Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities. Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations. Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification. Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments. Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership. Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews. Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption. Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners. Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation. What success looks like: - Customers have an agreed technical vision and a practical roadmap connected to their business priorities. - Executive ambition is translated into secure, scalable, and well-architected technical decisions. - Technical barriers are identified early and resolved through clear ownership and cross-functional collaboration. - Demonstrations and pilots lead to measurable adoption at scale. - Apple becomes a trusted part of the customer’s broader enterprise technology strategy. Minimum Qualifications * Strong technical depth across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid environments, identity and access management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking, application integration, and lifecycle operations. * Strong knowledge of identity and security concepts, including federation, SSO, MFA, conditional access, Zero Trust, PKI and certificates, endpoint security, data protection, and security governance. * Experience designing solutions that integrate devices and platforms with identity providers, MDM or UEM platforms, security tools, cloud services, SaaS applications, APIs, and line-of-business systems. * Strong consultative skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect technology decisions to business outcomes. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable without oversimplifying it. * Confidence engaging senior executives while maintaining credibility with architects, security teams, engineers, and operations teams. * Ability to influence across complex organizations and coordinate multiple internal, customer, and partner stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. jobs.title: Officer Account Executive-Financial Line
jobs.descriptionHtml: **EMPOWERING PEOPLE TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE** At Howden, we employ talent individuals and empower them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers. The entrepreneurial atmosphere is on of the biggest reason people love to work for us. We are a leading independent, global insurance brokers but have a noticeably flat hierarchy. It doesn't matter how junior or senior, anyone with good idea will be heard. This means our employees can shape their own career paths and determine their own success. This atmosphere attracts the brightest talent in the market. If that includes you, get in touch. Roles & Responsibilities 1. Maintains a positive attitude that promotes team work within the department and a favorable image of the company. 2. Prospecting, qualifying opportunities, initiate contact, and develop client relationships. 3. Proactively build a sustainable pipeline, create quality presentations, proposals and manage the sales cycle. 4. Maintains existing client’s records and organizes clients’ file. 5. Prepares invoices for clients (Reinsurance basis) 6. Coordinate claims after getting claim information from clients and from other team members. 7. Keeps clients/other team members informed of claim status on daily/weekly basis depending on the seriousness or urgency incidents. 8. Prepares monthly, quarterly and annual reports as required. 9. Ensures other assigned tasks to be carried out accurately and in a timely manner. 10. Checks accuracy and timeliness of policy from Insurer/Reinsurer to clients or Cedant 11. Checks accuracy of commission and prepares money remittance with Finance and Account for both Reinsurance and Direct basis. 12. Weekly/Monthly updates on FinLines account; i.e. weekly check-list update. 13. Deliver effective sales presentations and value propositions. 14. Close sales and develop long-term strategic relationships with customers. 15. Pro-actively develop new channels to market. Coordinate marketing events, seminars and road-shows. 16. Develop and maintain annual sales plans that support the quarterly. Job Specification * Education minimum Bachelor’s degree, Law, Economic, Account or Insurance * Special Product (FinLines, D&O,Cyber,PI,SPPI,Product Recall and Trade Dept Insurance/Reinsurance) with hard experience * Commitment and dedicate in job, be able to travel on business trip (local & international) * Good communication skills possess team group co-operation and higher sense of responsibility. * Being team player, energetic, well organized, and able to work under pressure

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location:** Jakarta **Employment Type:** Full-time **About Prodata** Prodata is an Indonesian IT solutions and technology distribution company, supporting enterprise customers and business partners with technology solutions and professional services. **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Manager to lead strategic enterprise accounts, develop major business opportunities, and drive significant revenue growth. This is a senior commercial leadership role for someone who can build executive-level relationships, lead complex sales opportunities, mobilize cross-functional teams, and convert strategic opportunities into successful business outcomes. The EAM will be supported by one or more dedicated Business Development Officers (BDOs), whom they are expected to guide and develop in generating qualified enterprise opportunities. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop strategic enterprise accounts and build relationships with senior decision-makers. * Create and lead high-value business opportunities, including competitive deals. * Direct and coach dedicated BDOs to identify enterprise prospects, reach key stakeholders, and secure qualified customer meetings. * Mobilize Presales, technology principals, business partners, and Prodata management to strengthen customer confidence and win projects. * Lead solution validation, demonstrations, POCs, negotiations, and deal closure. * Maintain customer relationships beyond PO issuance, monitor partner-delivered implementation progress, and ensure customer concerns are addressed. * Coordinate with Partners and internal teams on delivery commitments, commercial follow-ups, and account growth. * Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across solution areas. **Requirements** * **Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development.** * Experience in ICT, technology solutions, system integration, or IT distribution is strongly preferred. * Proven track record in developing new enterprise opportunities and closing major business deals. * Comfortable engaging Directors, VPs, IT leaders, and senior business stakeholders. * Strong capability in strategic selling, negotiation, pipeline management, and team coordination. * Able to lead and mobilize Business Development Officers, Presales, partners, and internal teams. * Commercially minded, accountable, persistent, and results-oriented. * Good communication and presentation skills; business-level English is preferred. **We are looking for a candidat who can create opportunities, lead teams, win major projects, protect customer relationships, and grow strategic accounts.** Interested candidates may submit their updated CV and relevant sales achievements awards. Kapten Tendean, with direct access to Jakarta inner ring road highway, 10 minutes to Whoosh Halim Station, close to diplomatic establishments and only 35 minutes drive from Soekarno Hatta International Airport. Providing 403 modern and superbly designed rooms, overlooking the glamorous urban scenery, ensuring comfort and serenity. Beyond its prime location, city views, and modern facilities, the hotel is committed to sustainability through its partnership with Green Key. It supports eco-friendly practices in water, energy, waste, cleaning, and sustainability education. **Job Description** To lead, develop, and maximize business opportunities within the corporate segment by establishing strong relationships with local and multinational companies, corporate organizations, and business partners. Responsible for developing and implementing effective sales strategies, managing key corporate accounts, generating new business, and achieving revenue targets to maximize the hotel's overall business performance. **Key Responsibilities** A. Sales Strategy & Business Development * Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the corporate segment. * Identify and explore new business opportunities from local companies, multinational corporations, corporate offices, and business organizations. * Develop market penetration strategies to increase the hotel's market share within the corporate segment. * Promote hotel products and services, including room accommodation, corporate rates, meeting packages, banquet facilities, catering, and other hotel offerings. * Conduct regular sales calls, client visits, business presentations, networking activities, and corporate meetings to generate new business. * Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and business opportunities to strengthen the hotel's competitive position. * Develop strategic partnerships with corporate clients to secure long-term business opportunities. B. Corporate Account Management & Client Relationship * Establish, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts and decision-makers. * Manage and develop strategic corporate accounts to maximize revenue production and business opportunities. * Conduct regular account reviews to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for account growth. * Understand corporate clients' business requirements and provide customized hotel solutions. * Lead corporate rate negotiations, prepare business agreements, and ensure contracts are aligned with hotel policies and revenue strategies. * Handle key client inquiries, negotiations, and escalated complaints professionally. * Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, account retention, and repeat business. C. Revenue Management & Sales Performance * Achieve and exceed assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the corporate segment. * Monitor corporate account production, room night contribution, average room rates, and overall revenue performance. * Work closely with the Revenue Management team to establish competitive corporate rates and optimize business opportunities. * Identify opportunities to increase room revenue, meeting room utilization, banquet revenue, and other hotel revenue streams. * Prepare accurate sales forecasts, revenue projections, and business development action plans. * Monitor sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions when necessary. * Ensure an appropriate balance between business volume, room rates, and overall profitability. D. Sales Team Leadership & Development * Lead, guide, and supervise the corporate sales team to ensure the achievement of individual and departmental sales targets. * Assign sales accounts, business development activities, and performance objectives to team members. * Monitor and evaluate team performance through regular sales meetings, account reviews, and performance discussions. * Provide coaching, guidance, and support to Assistant Sales Managers and Sales Executives to improve sales effectiveness. * Encourage teamwork, accountability, and continuous professional development within the sales team. * Ensure team members maintain updated account information, sales pipelines, and activity reports. E. Coordination & Administration * Coordinate with the Director of Sales, Revenue Management, Reservations, Front Office, Food & Beverage, and Banquet teams to ensure effective sales execution and service delivery. * Ensure corporate contracts, rate agreements, proposals, and quotations are prepared accurately and professionally. * Maintain updated corporate account databases, sales pipelines, and account production records in the hotel's sales system. * Prepare and submit regular sales performance reports, forecasts, market intelligence, and business development updates. * Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to the hotel's overall commercial strategy. * Ensure all sales activities comply with hotel policies, Accor standards, and established procedures. F. Customer Experience & Brand Representation * Ensure corporate clients receive professional and consistent service throughout their business engagement with the hotel. * Represent the hotel professionally during corporate meetings, networking events, trade shows, and business functions. * Promote Accor brand standards, hotel facilities, and loyalty programs to corporate clients. * Build a positive hotel image and strengthen the hotel's reputation within the corporate business community. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. * Minimum 1-2 years of experience in hotel sales, preferably in a managerial or supervisory position handling corporate accounts. * Strong knowledge of the corporate market, including local companies, multinational corporations, and business organizations. * Proven track record in achieving sales targets and developing strategic corporate accounts. * Strong network and established relationships with corporate clients and business decision-makers. * Good understanding of hotel revenue management, corporate rate structures, and account production analysis. * Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. * Good command of written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Proficient in Microsoft Office and hotel sales management systems. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. * Results-oriented, proactive, strategic, and able to work under pressure. **Additional Information** Diversity & Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities. Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities. When applying, do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can take them into consideration.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** **Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto** Novelty among the top-notch properties of south Jakarta. Conveniently located in the golden triangle area of business, Gatot Subroto. Accessible via Jl. Gatot Subroto and Jl. Kapten Tendean, with direct access to Jakarta inner ring road highway, 10 minutes to Whoosh Halim Station, close to diplomatic establishments and only 35 minutes drive from Soekarno Hatta International Airport. Providing 403 modern and superbly designed rooms, overlooking the glamorous urban scenery, ensuring comfort and serenity. Beyond its prime location, city views, and modern facilities, the hotel is committed to sustainability through its partnership with Green Key. It supports eco-friendly practices in water, energy, waste, cleaning, and sustainability education. **Job Description** To support the Director of Sales and Sales Manager in developing, managing, and maximizing business opportunities within the corporate segment. Responsible for maintaining existing corporate accounts, acquiring new business, promoting hotel products and services, and achieving assigned revenue targets through effective sales activities, account management, and strong client relationships. **Key Responsibilities** A. Sales & Business Development * Assist in developing and implementing sales strategies to achieve corporate segment revenue targets. * Identify and develop new business opportunities from local and multinational companies, corporate offices, and business organizations. * Promote hotel facilities and services, including room accommodation, corporate rates, meeting packages, banquets, and food and beverage offerings. * Conduct regular sales calls, client visits, sales presentations, and business meetings to generate new business. * Prepare proposals, quotations, and corporate agreements to attract potential clients. * Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and corporate business opportunities to strengthen the hotel's market position. B. Account Management & Client Relationship * Maintain and develop strong relationships with existing corporate clients and key decision-makers. * Identify clients' business needs and provide suitable hotel products and services. * Conduct regular account reviews and follow-ups to ensure continuous business production. * Handle client inquiries, requests, and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution. * Develop long-term partnerships to increase account retention and repeat business. * Ensure corporate accounts receive excellent service and consistent follow-up. C. Revenue & Sales Performance * Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the corporate segment. * Monitor account production and identify opportunities to increase revenue contribution. * Negotiate corporate rates, contracts, and business agreements in accordance with hotel policies and approved pricing strategies. * Develop sales action plans to maximize room revenue, meeting packages, and other hotel revenue opportunities. * Prepare sales forecasts and monitor business performance against established targets. * Identify opportunities to maximize revenue during low-demand periods and special corporate events. D. Coordination & Administration * Coordinate with Revenue Management, Reservations, Front Office, Food & Beverage, and Banquet teams to ensure smooth delivery of corporate client requirements. * Ensure corporate contracts, rate agreements, and account information are properly prepared and maintained. * Maintain accurate records of sales activities, client visits, account production, and business opportunities in the hotel's sales system. * Prepare regular sales reports, account updates, and business development progress reports. * Participate in departmental sales meetings and provide updates on market developments and account performance. * Ensure compliance with hotel policies, Accor standards, and established sales procedures. E. Teamwork & Leadership Support * Support the Director of Sales and Sales Manager in achieving the department's overall objectives. * Assist in guiding and supporting Sales Executives in their daily sales activities when required. * Share corporate market insights, sales leads, and business opportunities with the sales team. * Collaborate with other departments to ensure excellent guest and client experiences. * Demonstrate professionalism and maintain a positive working relationship with internal and external stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. * Minimum 1-2 years of experience in hotel sales, preferably handling corporate accounts. * Previous experience in corporate account management and business development. * Good knowledge of the corporate market, including local companies, multinational companies, and business organizations. * Proven ability to achieve sales targets and develop new business opportunities. * Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. * Good command of written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Proficient in Microsoft Office and hotel sales systems. * Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. * Customer-oriented, proactive, target-driven, and able to work independently as well as in a team. **Additional Information** Diversity & Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities. Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities. When applying, do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can take them into consideration.
