jobs.title: Senior Integrated Producer (German Speaker)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand

Job Description

As a Senior Integrated Producer, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end production process, ensuring seamless execution, financial oversight, and stakeholder coordination. You are expected to balance project management and production expertise, delivering high-budget, complex, and multi-market projects while driving efficiencies, mentorship, and strategic problem-solving. You will collaborate closely with Client Management, Resource Management, and Creative teams, acting as a trusted production lead while maintaining financial and operational control over projects.

Working on a high-profile social media retainer for a titan in the global streaming and entertainment sector, you will sit at the absolute heart of our German market operations. This role is ideal for a producer who thrives in client-facing environments, enjoys hands-on workflow coordination, and brings a strong project management background to fast-paced agency retainers.

 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary, trusted client-facing lead for German market operations - building strong direct relationships, leading status syncs, navigating client feedback, and providing strategic production solutions.

  • Agile Workflow & Daily Operations: Run daily scrums, triage incoming brief requests, and assign workloads to content managers, copywriters, and motion designers to keep daily social streams moving seamlessly.

  • Financial Oversight & Costing: Lead end-to-end project costing, budgeting, financial forecasting, PO management, and cost reconciliation across high-volume retainer scopes and bespoke campaign spikes.

  • Native Quality Control (QC): Perform meticulous quality control on all German-language social assets (static, video, motion graphics) to guarantee absolute linguistic accuracy, brand alignment, and cultural tone before client delivery.

  • Retainer & Content Production: Oversee end-to-end execution of fast-turnaround social assets, localised multi-market campaigns, and platform-native video deliverables.

  • Resourcing & Mentorship: Partner with Resource Management to cast internal teams and external freelancers effectively, while providing mentorship and workflow guidance to mid-level and junior team members.

     

Qualifications

  • Language Expertise: Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken) is required, along with full professional fluency in English.

  • Social Retainer Background: Extensive experience in an agency environment managing high-volume, fast-turnaround social media retainers is a must.

  • Project Management Synergy: While this is a Senior Integrated Producer role, candidates bringing a strong foundation or background in Project Management - experienced in running scrums, structuring workflows, and tracking deliverables - will be a natural fit.

  • Financial Mastery: Proven proficiency in project costing, budget management, scope estimation, and financial risk mitigation.

  • Client-Facing Mindset: Genuinely enjoys being client-facing and comfortable serving as the day-to-day operational contact for high-level brand partners.

  • Rigorous QC Standards: An exceptional eye for detail, proofreading, and linguistic/visual quality assurance for social content.

  • Experience delivering marketing or social campaigns within film, streaming, TV, or broader entertainment media.

  • Exposure to live-action shoot production logistics and modern AI-driven production workflows.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to

  • • €55K – €60K

jobs.title: Partner Sales Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

A strong partner ecosystem is crucial to the success and growth of Kong's business. Partners are a strategic imperative for Kong's continued growth and market expansion. As customer requirements become more complex, we need partners with the capability and capacity to help customers implement, support and grow their usage of Kong. We work closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure partners are integrated throughout the sales cycle, both pre- and post-sale.

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

Responsibilities

  • Own the partner revenue number for your assigned territory. Sell Kong's full portfolio (products, renewals, professional services, and support) through and with focus partners.

  • Build the joint go-to-market plan with your territory's sales team. Identify and sign new partners where there are gaps.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline: set targets, run the cadence, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable to them, favoring net-new sourced business over tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by coordinating deal registration, lead sharing, and co-selling motions for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect.

  • Build joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides actually use.

  • Run joint marketing events that generate pipeline, not just logos on a banner.

  • Get inside your partners' business: understand how they make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together. Pull in the right cross-functional support (enablement, CX, marketing, ops) to make the projects land.

  • Build a focus partner plan for your territory and execute it alongside sales engineering, SDRs, customer success, and marketing.

  • Partner with and Partner Sales Engineers to ensure partners have the technical readiness needed to sell and deliver Kong solutions.

  • Build, maintain, and manage relationships with the Kong field sales organization. Proactively engage with Kong AEs, ASMs and geo leadership.

  • Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of Kong team members, including sales leadership and support, as needed to meet sales targets and partner sales objectives.

  • Facilitate territory mapping and identification of new joint opportunities. Resolve route conflicts appropriately.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews (QBRs) within your assigned territory, and participate in annual planning within the Partner organization.

  • Provide weekly forecasts and/or progress reports, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and other partner management systems.

  • Escalate critical business issues to Partner Sales team management.

  • Prepare presentations, territory plans and reports as required.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales as needed.

Requirements

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the role, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market across channel, GSI, and hyperscaler partners

  • A bias toward net-new, sourced business, not just tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway

  • Comfort running many partners and many activities in parallel without losing the thread on any of them

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API/AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling motions

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems (e.g., Partner Portal)

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to remain calm under pressure

  • Established personal network within the industry

  • Results-oriented perspective

  • Interest in Kong and open source software; ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Commercial Enablement - AI & Automation (German-Speaking) (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und kurzfristig verfügbare Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen nutzen unsere Buchungsplattform, um ihren Personalbedarf in Echtzeit zu decken, während Studierende über unsere Zenjob-App Nebenjobs finden, die sich perfekt mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Zenjobber und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen deutschen Großstädten teilen unsere Überzeugung: Gute Arbeit ist kein Zufall. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Deine Rolle

Als Teil des Commercial Enablement Teams hilfst du unserem Sales und Account Management Team, unsere Kundenprozesse smarter, schneller und skalierbarer zu machen.

Mit AI und pragmatischen Workflow Tools unterstützt du dabei, Automatisierungspotenziale entlang unserer Go-to-Market-Prozesse von Lead bis Bestandskunde zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Sales und Commercial Operations Prozessen sowie der Identifikation von Effizienzpotenzialen

  • Mitarbeit beim Aufbau von Automatisierungen zur Reduktion operativer Ineffizienzen im Sales und Account Management Umfeld (z. B. mit n8n)

  • Unterstützung bei der Integration von AI in kommerzielle Prozesse, z. B. Lead Generation oder CRM Workflows (Salesforce)

  • Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung pragmatischer Workflows und schneller Tests neuer Use Cases mit Hilfe von AI Tools wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Claude

  • Unterstützung bei der Verbindung unserer Tools und Systeme über APIs, Webhooks oder No Code Plattformen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management, Revenue Operations sowie Product & Engineering

  • Mitarbeit beim Testen, Optimieren und Weiterentwickeln funktionierender Lösungen

Dein Profil

  • Starkes Interesse daran, wie Sales und Go to Market Teams arbeiten

  • Strukturierte Denkweise und pragmatischer Lösungsansatz

  • Interesse an AI, Automatisierung und digitalen Geschäftsprozessen

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Tools, Automatisierungen oder digitalen Workflows von Vorteil

  • Grundverständnisse von Programmierung sowie grundlegenden Web und API Konzepten wünschenswert

  • Laufendes Studium mit technischem, digitalem oder wirtschaftsnahem Schwerpunkt

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Rahmendaten

  • Arbeitszeit: 20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters

  • Standort: Berliner Büro, mit 2 Tagen pro Woche vor Ort

  • Dauer: Mindestlaufzeit von 12 Monaten

Das bieten wir

🌱 Umfassendes Onboarding: Unternehmens-Onboarding, regelmäßige Trainings und eine offene Feedbackkultur

⭐ Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Arbeiten im Büro und remote ermöglicht, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, deinen Hund mit ins Büro zu bringen

🏋️‍♂️ 30 € Zuschuss für den Urban Sports Club, 25 % Rabatt auf eine FitX-Mitgliedschaft

🪩Vierteljährliche Team-Events, Winter- und Sommerfeste, Budget für Geburtstage und Jubiläen unserer Mitarbeitenden

🎥 Schau dir unser Office Tour Video an.

jobs.descriptionHtml: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return, we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development, including offering you support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/R ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our customer data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of customer data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Efficiently resolve any problems prior to raising and issue of invoice</li> <li>Implement and comply with the Canonical credit control policy</li> <li>Maximise cash collection through the effective collection of debts and maintain records to track debt collection through to conclusion</li> <li>Ensure payments are received in line with contractual terms</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organization skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an enterprise level accounting system&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program &amp; Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote&nbsp;</p>

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We have new senior leadership opportunities in our Global Alliances and Channels organisations, to lead business development and partnership with some of the most important actors in the global technology sector. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities</li> <li>Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships</li> <li>An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.<br></a></p>

jobs.title: Alliances Field Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an <strong>Alliances Field Engineer</strong> to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.</p> <p>Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.</p> <p>We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.</p> <p>We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments</li> <li>Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)</li> <li>Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX</li> <li>Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center</li> <li>Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners</li> <li>Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions</li> </ul> <p>If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.</p> <h3>What we are looking for in you </h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds</li> <li>Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> <li>High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments</li> <li>Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs</li> <li>Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps</li> <li>Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Associate Support Engineer</strong> to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we’ve never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and  customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals.</li> <li>Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences.</li> <li>Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line.</li> <li>Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines.</li> <li>Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations.</li> <li>Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role.</li> <li>Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency.</li> <li>A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data.</li> <li>Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line reporting and leading through influence and collaboration.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets.</li> <li>Experience overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, mission-driven, or community-governed organization, especially one with a commercial or earned-revenue arm.</li> <li>Real understanding of AI, how it works, data licensing and content provenance debates </li> <li>Familiarity with the Wikimedia movement, Wikipedia, or free-knowledge/open-content spaces.</li> <li>Background in tech, media, or platform companies navigating AI-related content, licensing, or data issues.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$<span data-sheets-root="1">118,361</span> to US$<span data-sheets-root="1">182,658 </span>with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)<br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (<em>*citizens/permanent residents only)</em></p> <p>We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.</p> <p>All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.</p> <p><em><strong>If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at recruiting@wikimedia.org or +1 (415) 839-6885.</strong></em></p> <p><strong>More information</strong></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Applicant_privacy_policy"><strong>Applicant Privacy Policy</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/"><strong>Wikimedia Foundation</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mvPYF_erNA&list=PLVx9pX-VnGVh9Akb-O-SAKZ-GDTVTHZqS&index=8"><strong>What does the Wikimedia Foundation do?</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7gATwhhGrPk&list=PLVx9pX-VnGVh9Akb-O-SAKZ-GDTVTHZqS&index=1"><strong>What makes Wikipedia different from social media platforms?</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/wiki/Our_projects"><strong>Our Projects</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://techblog.wikimedia.org/"><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/news/"><strong>News from across the Wikimedia movement</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/"><strong>Wikimedia Blog</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Strategy/Wikimedia_movement/2017"><strong>Wikimedia 2030</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <div id="l-content"></div>

jobs.title: Community Management Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.</p> <p>Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)</p> <p><strong>Ideally You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Digital Culture Native:</strong> Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.</li> <li><strong>A Strong Communicator:</strong> Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.</li> <li><strong>An Organized Framework Builder:</strong> Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.</li> <li><strong>A Community Connector:</strong> Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Aware Learner:</strong> Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Community Engagement & Copywriting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.</li> <li>Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.</li> <li>Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Trends & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.</li> <li>Support testing of social listening and moderation tools to improve community response time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tracking & Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor channel activity, track audience sentiment, and assist with monthly performance reporting.</li> <li>Participate in creative experimentation to see which copy and engagement styles resonate best.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>1–3 years</strong> of hands-on experience in social media execution, community management, or digital storytelling.</li> <li><strong>Short-Form Native:</strong> Active familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Moderation:</strong> Experience writing social copy, engaging in comment sections, or moderating online channels.</li> <li><strong>Basic Tool Familiarity:</strong> Exposure to social management, analytics, or listening tools.</li> <li><strong>Good Judgment:</strong> High emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive comments and know when to escalate risks.</li> <li><strong>Global Mindset:</strong> Awareness of cross-cultural nuances and working with diverse global audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualities That Matter to Us</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passion for the Wikimedia mission and free knowledge.</li> <li>Flexibility working with distributed teams across time zones.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit, curiosity, and a real love for internet culture.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$62,074 to US$93,077 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)</p> <p><strong>For US-based applicants: this position is part of the Communication Workers of America bargaining unit.</strong><br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (<em>*citizens/permanent residents only)</em><br><br>We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.</p> <p>All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.</p> <p><em><strong>If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>HEAD OF MARKETING</strong></p> <p><strong>Reports to: Senior Director of External Communications</strong></p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to help establish and oversee a new function responsible for product and integrated marketing. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit that hosts Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. Product marketing is a new function being established at the Foundation, and the Head of Marketing will help build it from the ground up. They will bring our existing integrated marketing work together with this new capability into one unified function that will help ensure Wikipedia remains visible and relevant to generations of readers around the world.</p> <p>Positioned within the External Communications team, this senior manager level role will collaborate with Foundation stakeholders to shape our go-to-market approach. While the primary audience focus for the role is readers, they will also help develop a unified view of audience engagement across the Foundation’s external audiences.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates across UTC+2 to UTC-4 (Central European through Eastern Time). Given the globally distributed nature of the team and role requirements, flexibility outside standard hours should be expected.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities will include: </strong></p> <p><strong>Product marketing leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the Senior Director of External Communications to help establish product marketing as an emerging function, developing the processes and go-to-market approach needed to engage new external audiences.</li> <li>Recruit and lead team members overseeing product marketing, ensuring alignment with strategy and organisational needs.</li> <li>Lead coordination with Foundation departments to establish a shared approach to external audience engagement, and campaign planning.</li> <li>Bring a retention and lifetime-engagement lens to product marketing planning.</li> <li>Develop a foundation for product marketing metrics including audience growth, campaign impact, adoption/retention improvement, stronger brand awareness, or clearer GTM process.</li> <li>Establish strong commercial judgement within the audience and competitive landscape, able to identify and prioritise market needs and balance that with corresponding product features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Brand and channel marketing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the Brand Studio and Brand Management team to develop a shared global brand marketing approach. </li> <li>Line-manage team members responsible for integrated and performance marketing, including paid media and owned digital experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate with Insights and Brand Studio on developing new marketing briefs, staffing for new projects, and development of campaigns and activations that grow global brand visibility, likeability, and awareness.</li> <li>Ensure strategic alignment between the briefs product marketing produces and how the wider marketing and communications team adopts them.</li> <li>Oversee the development and execution of the Foundation's web, SEO/GEO, and app store strategy as core organic growth channels. </li> <li>Architect and oversee decisions on marketing technology and tooling, ensuring seamless data integration between CRM platforms, martech systems, product analytics tools, and communication channels.</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of trends, platform shifts, emerging channels, and marketing tools. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Team leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading and line managing a multidisciplinary marketing team.</li> <li>Actively managing priorities across the dual remit of product marketing and integrated marketing, ensuring sufficient attention is directed to both.</li> <li>Overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of marketing experience, including significant knowledge of product marketing (at least 5 years in a b2c setting), and line management of multi-disciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience at a major website, online publisher/platform, growing and engaging audiences at scale globally.</li> <li>Experience building product messaging and value propositions, with global audience segmentation and lifecycle marketing experience.</li> <li>Ability to adapt tone, voice, and message across different cultural contexts.</li> <li>Experience in agile, fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous marketing environments, comfortable balancing both a hands on and strategic approach, while handling long-term strategy building with short-term performance demands.</li> <li>Experience in leading through influence and collaboration to drive alignment across teams and departments. </li> <li>Experience developing and overseeing a multichannel strategy across paid, owned, and earned media.</li> <li>Ability to operate as a peer with internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with campaign analytics, with the ability to translate data into shared strategic decisions.</li> <li>Direct experience evaluating or implementing marketing technology, such as CRM or audience and campaign data platforms.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets, including leading a distributed team.</li> <li>Budget management experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d also love it if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Curiosity and enthusiasm for the Wikimedia mission.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free
